rules._note: Proposed rules this catalogue assumes (design/10). None is in the game.

loud._note: An item more than two bands above your stars is Loud: its effect line, rune and toll are dormant and enemies of its band notice you from 50% further. Base numbers (and satellites, by Brent's ruling) always work.

caps_per_star._note: Every other design/06 cap stays as it is.

leeching.text: Your maximum health is lower while it is worn.

safe_hands.text: The hidden growth a delve earns is a tenth smaller. The notebook only ever says the star feels lighter.

slow_mending.text: Natural healing is a fifth slower.

heavy.text: It weighs about twice what it should; the worn-weight rule does the rest.

turned_back.text: Hits from behind do a quarter more to you.

running_hot.text: Its flow leaves half again as much reflux.

bound.text: Cannot be taken off except by a runesetter in town ($400). Reserved; no catalogue item uses it yet.

knuckles.label: Knuckles
knuckles.trait_text: A landed base strike sheds 2 reflux instead of 1. Still works, at the off-hand rate, with the striking arm gone.

dagger.label: Daggers
dagger.trait_text: The bonus for hitting an enemy's back is doubled (+60%).

blade.label: Blades
blade.trait_text: Carries a small guard of its own: 12 points, back after 2 s. Adds to a shield's.

axe.label: Axes and cleavers
axe.trait_text: Each hit leaves 1 stack of Bleeding (5 a second for 4 s, up to 5 stacks).

hammer.label: Hammers and maces
hammer.trait_text: Enemy front armour and shields count for half against it.

polearm.label: Polearms
polearm.trait_text: +20% damage to a target standing further away than bare-handed reach.

great.label: Great weapons
great.trait_text: Strike skills used with it reach 0.6 m further and sweep 20 degrees wider. The base strike stays single-target.

thrown.label: Thrown
thrown.trait_text: A fixed number of throws per fight; all of them are back in the brace when the fight ends.

sling.label: Slings
sling.trait_text: Stones are free and never run out. Lead shot, if carried, is used first.

bow.label: Bows
bow.trait_text: +2% damage per metre of flight past 6 m, up to +20%.

crossbow.label: Crossbows
crossbow.trait_text: The shot is instant; the wait comes after, and you can strike while it is spanned. Its damage is the machine's, not yours.

flue.label: Flues
flue.trait_text: Each shot burns reflux from your hottest affinity and is tinted with it. Below the cost it clicks dry.

shield.label: Shields
shield.trait_text: Hits from the front 120 degrees drain the guard before your health. Heavy attacks drain double. Broken: you are staggered 0.4 s and it returns after its recovery time. Down while you shoot a two-handed ranged weapon.

focus.label: Sumps and slates
focus.trait_text: One small casting effect. No guard.

knuckle_wraps.name: Knuckle Wraps
knuckle_wraps.desc: Cloth and tape. Saves the skin, not the bone.

iron_knuckles.name: Iron Knuckles
iron_knuckles.desc: Banded iron over the fist. Honest work.

notched_dusters.name: Notched Dusters
notched_dusters.desc: Each notch was somebody. The maker left room for more.

venting_dusters.name: Venting Notched Dusters

recipe.note: fails 10% of the time: ink and fee lost, item kept (design/06 8.5)

venting_dusters.desc: The runes run warm after a cast. That is the heat leaving.

debtors_knuckles.name: Debtor's Knuckles
debtors_knuckles.effect_text: Faster and harder than any plain pair.
debtors_knuckles.desc: They hit as if something were owed. Something is.

serrated_dagger.name: Serrated Dagger
serrated_dagger.desc: An invader's blade. Light, quick, and legal to keep when it comes out of a passage.

needle_dirk.name: Needle Dirk
needle_dirk.desc: Narrow enough to find the gap. You still have to find the gap.

quick_needle_dirk.name: Quick Needle Dirk

recipe.note: fails 10% of the time: ink and fee lost, item kept (design/06 8.5)

quick_needle_dirk.desc: It is back in your hand before you have decided.

notched_hanger.name: Notched Hanger
notched_hanger.desc: A short sword that has been used as a pry bar, and remembers.

commander_blade.name: Commander's Blade
commander_blade.desc: Long, balanced, and made for someone taller than you.

duelling_sword.name: Duelling Sword
duelling_sword.desc: Built for one opponent and a referee. Passages supply neither.

keen_duelling_sword.name: Keen Duelling Sword

recipe.note: fails 10% of the time: ink and fee lost, item kept (design/06 8.5)

keen_duelling_sword.desc: The edge is written on as well as ground.

bailiffs_sabre.name: Bailiff's Sabre
bailiffs_sabre.effect_text: Kill bounties pay a tenth more.
bailiffs_sabre.desc: It prefers work that pays. It will see that you do too.

invader_cleaver.name: Invader's Cleaver
invader_cleaver.desc: Too heavy for the thing that carried it. Slow, and it ends arguments.

felling_axe.name: Felling Axe
felling_axe.desc: The tree never fought back. Adjust your expectations.

bearded_axe.name: Bearded Axe
bearded_axe.desc: The hooked lower edge is for shields. Or ankles.

staggering_bearded_axe.name: Staggering Bearded Axe

recipe.note: fails 10% of the time: ink and fee lost, item kept (design/06 8.5)

staggering_bearded_axe.desc: Things it hits take a moment to remember where they were.

butchers_share.name: Butcher's Share
butchers_share.effect_text: Each hit opens two bleeding stacks, not one.
butchers_share.desc: The cut is generous. The butcher keeps a portion.

flanged_mace.name: Flanged Mace
flanged_mace.desc: Six flanges. It does not care which one arrives.

lead_cored_mace.name: Lead-Cored Mace
lead_cored_mace.desc: Heavier than it looks, which is the entire design.

stubborn_lead_cored_mace.name: Stubborn Lead-Cored Mace

recipe.note: fails 10% of the time: ink and fee lost, item kept (design/06 8.5)

stubborn_lead_cored_mace.desc: Swinging it plants your feet for you.

assessors_gavel.name: Assessor's Gavel
assessors_gavel.effect_text: Enemies it staggers stay staggered half a second longer.
assessors_gavel.desc: When it comes down, proceedings stop.

boar_stick.name: Boar Stick
boar_stick.desc: A pole, a point, and a crossbar so the boar stops there.

ash_spear.name: Ash Spear
ash_spear.desc: The oldest idea there is: be further away than the other one.

wall_hook.name: Wall-Hook
wall_hook.desc: For pulling things off ramparts. Works at ground level too.

partisan.name: Partisan
partisan.desc: A spear that went to a good school.

long_partisan.name: Long Partisan

recipe.note: fails 10% of the time: ink and fee lost, item kept (design/06 8.5)

long_partisan.desc: A hand's width longer than it measures.

pike_of_the_last_rank.name: Pike of the Last Rank
pike_of_the_last_rank.effect_text: The bonus for striking at the tip is doubled.
pike_of_the_last_rank.desc: Carried by the one who stood behind everyone else. It has opinions about advancing.

quarry_maul.name: Quarry Maul
quarry_maul.desc: It broke stone for forty years. You are softer.

war_maul.name: War Maul
war_maul.desc: One swing, one decision, no revisions.

greatblade.name: Greatblade
greatblade.desc: A plain yard and a half of steel. Both hands, all of your attention.

tithe_cutter.name: Tithe-Cutter
tithe_cutter.desc: Takes a tenth of whatever stands in front of it. Sometimes more.

keen_tithe_cutter.name: Keen Tithe-Cutter

recipe.note: fails 10% of the time: ink and fee lost, item kept (design/06 8.5)

keen_tithe_cutter.desc: The fuller is full of small careful writing.

landlord.name: Landlord
landlord.effect_text: A strike on a staggered enemy does triple, not double.
landlord.desc: It takes everything, and it is never satisfied with the state of the place.

brace_of_nails.name: Brace of Nails
brace_of_nails.desc: Six-inch roofing nails. They fly badly and arrive anyway.

throwing_knives.name: Throwing Knives
throwing_knives.desc: Six, balanced. You will get most of them back.

short_javelins.name: Short Javelins
short_javelins.desc: Three. Each goes through the first thing and has a word with the second.

true_throwing_knives.name: True Throwing Knives

recipe.note: fails 10% of the time: ink and fee lost, item kept (design/06 8.5)

true_throwing_knives.desc: They correct themselves a little. Do not ask how.

cord_sling.name: Cord Sling
cord_sling.desc: A cord, a pouch, and whatever is on the ground.

braided_sling.name: Braided Sling
braided_sling.desc: Someone's grandmother made this, and meant it.

staff_sling.name: Staff Sling
staff_sling.desc: A sling on a pole. Throws a rock the size of a fist over a wall.

light_drawn_braided_sling.name: Light-Drawn Braided Sling

recipe.note: fails 10% of the time: ink and fee lost, item kept (design/06 8.5)

light_drawn_braided_sling.desc: The cord comes round sooner than it should.

bent_stave.name: Bent Stave
bent_stave.desc: It was a bow once. It is still mostly a bow.

hunting_bow.name: Hunting Bow
hunting_bow.desc: For deer. The principle carries over.

short_recurve.name: Short Recurve
short_recurve.desc: Short enough to shoot while leaving.

rampart_bow.name: Rampart Bow
rampart_bow.desc: Taken off a wall, along with the one who was using it.

true_rampart_bow.name: True Rampart Bow

recipe.note: fails 10% of the time: ink and fee lost, item kept (design/06 8.5)

true_rampart_bow.desc: The grip has been written on by someone who shot better than you.

latchbow.name: Latchbow
latchbow.desc: One hand, one bolt, one opinion.

gate_crossbow.name: Gate Crossbow
gate_crossbow.desc: The lever does the work. It does not care how many stars you have.

windlass_arbalest.name: Windlass Arbalest
windlass_arbalest.desc: Crank, crank, crank, crank. Then one very final noise.

light_drawn_gate_crossbow.name: Light-Drawn Gate Crossbow

recipe.note: fails 10% of the time: ink and fee lost, item kept (design/06 8.5)

light_drawn_gate_crossbow.desc: The string wants to be back.

tin_flue.name: Tin Flue
tin_flue.desc: A runed pipe. It coughs your own reflux at whatever you point it at.

brass_flue.name: Brass Flue
brass_flue.desc: Better seams. Less of it comes back up your arm.

venting_brass_flue.name: Venting Brass Flue

recipe.note: fails 10% of the time: ink and fee lost, item kept (design/06 8.5)

venting_brass_flue.desc: It breathes for you even when you are not shooting.

barrel_lid.name: Barrel Lid
barrel_lid.desc: Oak, iron hoop, rope handle. Smells of herring.

buckler.name: Buckler
buckler.desc: Small, quick, and back in place before the next one lands.

plank_shield.name: Plank Shield
plank_shield.desc: Three boards and a boss. It will take what it is given.

banded_round_shield.name: Banded Round Shield
banded_round_shield.desc: Iron rim, rawhide face, somebody's initials.

cut_down_pavise.name: Cut-Down Pavise
cut_down_pavise.desc: Sawn to fit a person. Still a door.

warded_buckler.name: Warded Buckler

recipe.note: fails 10% of the time: ink and fee lost, item kept (design/06 8.5)

warded_buckler.desc: What gets past it gets past it gently.

recipe.note: fails 10% of the time: ink and fee lost, item kept (design/06 8.5)

clay_sump.name: Clay Sump
clay_sump.desc: A stoppered jar. Some of what your casting leaves behind settles in it instead of you.

brass_sump.name: Brass Sump
brass_sump.desc: Holds more, leaks less, hums when full.

chalk_slate.name: Chalk Slate
chalk_slate.desc: Your working, written out where you can see it. Fewer mistakes, less waste.

runesetters_slate.name: Runesetter's Slate
runesetters_slate.desc: Someone else's working. Theirs was better.

oilcloth_hood.name: Oilcloth Hood
oilcloth_hood.desc: Sheds rain and, for reasons nobody has written down, a little heat.

quilted_coif.name: Quilted Coif
quilted_coif.desc: Padding for under a helm. Many stop here.

dented_pot_helm.name: Dented Pot Helm
dented_pot_helm.desc: The dent is the previous owner's review.

boiled_cap.name: Boiled Cap
boiled_cap.desc: Leather cooked until it gave up being skin.

banded_helm.name: Banded Helm
banded_helm.desc: Iron straps over hide. Looks like a barrel. Works like one.

kettle_helm.name: Kettle Helm
kettle_helm.desc: A wide brim for things falling off walls.

visored_sallet.name: Visored Sallet
visored_sallet.desc: You see a slot of the world. The slot is enough.

tethered_quilted_coif.name: Tethered Quilted Coif

recipe.note: fails 10% of the time: ink and fee lost, item kept (design/06 8.5)

tethered_quilted_coif.desc: The soul goes a little further from a head that is wearing this.

warded_banded_helm.name: Warded Banded Helm

recipe.note: fails 10% of the time: ink and fee lost, item kept (design/06 8.5)

warded_banded_helm.desc: Blows to the head are remembered less.

blinkered_helm.name: Blinkered Helm
blinkered_helm.effect_text: The best wound protection a helm can give.
blinkered_helm.desc: Nothing gets in. That includes most of the view.

patched_coat.name: Patched Coat
patched_coat.desc: More patch than coat. It is yours.

padded_jack.name: Padded Jack
padded_jack.desc: Quilted linen. Breathes, which matters more than you would think.

husk_hide_jack.name: Husk-Hide Jack
husk_hide_jack.desc: Invader hide, badly cured. It kept one of them alive for a while.

boiled_leather_cuirass.name: Boiled Leather Cuirass
boiled_leather_cuirass.desc: Stiff as a door for the first month.

ringed_hauberk.name: Ringed Hauberk
ringed_hauberk.desc: Ten thousand rings, every one closed by hand.

invaders_breastplate.name: Invader's Breastplate
invaders_breastplate.desc: Fitted to a different shape of chest. You will know by evening.

plate_cuirass.name: Plate Cuirass
plate_cuirass.desc: Steel front and back. The heat has nowhere to go, and neither do you.

fitted_harness.name: Fitted Harness
fitted_harness.desc: Measured for you. The price says so twice.

knitting_padded_jack.name: Knitting Padded Jack

recipe.note: fails 10% of the time: ink and fee lost, item kept (design/06 8.5)

knitting_padded_jack.desc: Wounds under it close as if they had somewhere to be.

warded_ringed_hauberk.name: Warded Ringed Hauberk

recipe.note: fails 10% of the time: ink and fee lost, item kept (design/06 8.5)

warded_ringed_hauberk.desc: One ring in every hundred is written on.

venting_plate_cuirass.name: Venting Plate Cuirass

recipe.note: fails 10% of the time: ink and fee lost, item kept (design/06 8.5)

venting_plate_cuirass.desc: Plate that lets the heat out. Somebody finally asked.

paupers_shroud.name: Pauper's Shroud
paupers_shroud.effect_text: Every ability costs a tenth less.
paupers_shroud.desc: Thin enough to cast through. Thin enough for most things.

work_gloves.name: Work Gloves
work_gloves.desc: Split palm, one finger missing. The glove's, so far.

kid_gloves.name: Kid Gloves
kid_gloves.desc: Soft enough to feel the grip. That is the point of them.

draw_glove.name: Draw Glove
draw_glove.desc: Three fingers of horn. The string leaves cleanly.

rope_bound_bracers.name: Rope-Bound Bracers
rope_bound_bracers.desc: Slats and cord. An invader's idea of a forearm.

hide_bracers.name: Hide Bracers
hide_bracers.desc: Something to put between an edge and the arm you need.

splinted_vambraces.name: Splinted Vambraces
splinted_vambraces.desc: Steel strips sewn in. You can stop a blade with these, once or twice.

plate_mitts.name: Plate Mitts
plate_mitts.desc: No fingers to lose track of.

articulated_gauntlets.name: Articulated Gauntlets
articulated_gauntlets.desc: Every knuckle its own little hinge, every hinge a little hammer.

quick_kid_gloves.name: Quick Kid Gloves

recipe.note: fails 10% of the time: ink and fee lost, item kept (design/06 8.5)

quick_kid_gloves.desc: Stitched with a line of very small writing along each seam.

staggering_plate_mitts.name: Staggering Plate Mitts

recipe.note: fails 10% of the time: ink and fee lost, item kept (design/06 8.5)

staggering_plate_mitts.desc: Whatever you are holding lands as if it weighed more.

street_boots.name: Street Boots
street_boots.desc: Resoled twice. The uppers are original.

soft_runners.name: Soft Runners
soft_runners.desc: No heel, no nails, no noise.

couriers_boots.name: Courier's Boots
couriers_boots.desc: Made for people who are paid by the mile.

dead_mans_boots.name: Dead Man's Boots
dead_mans_boots.desc: They were his size. Close enough.

hobnailed_boots.name: Hobnailed Boots
hobnailed_boots.desc: They grip. You stay where you stood.

shod_marching_boots.name: Shod Marching Boots
shod_marching_boots.desc: Twenty miles a day, every day, without comment.

greave_boots.name: Greave Boots
greave_boots.desc: Shin plates riveted to the boot. Kicking things becomes an option.

sabatons.name: Sabatons
sabatons.desc: Steel to the toe. Stairs become a negotiation.

sure_footed_hobnailed_boots.name: Sure-Footed Hobnailed Boots

recipe.note: fails 10% of the time: ink and fee lost, item kept (design/06 8.5)

sure_footed_hobnailed_boots.desc: The nails are set in a pattern that means something.

stubborn_sabatons.name: Stubborn Sabatons

recipe.note: fails 10% of the time: ink and fee lost, item kept (design/06 8.5)

stubborn_sabatons.desc: Something would have to move the floor.

runaways_shoes.name: Runaway's Shoes
runaways_shoes.effect_text: A tenth faster on your feet.
runaways_shoes.desc: Fast. They assume you will use them.

flour_sack.name: Flour Sack
flour_sack.desc: A sack and a length of rope. Technically a pack.

canvas_pack.name: Canvas Pack
canvas_pack.desc: A cheap backpack. Everything you own fits, for now.

drovers_pack.name: Drover's Pack
drovers_pack.desc: Wide straps and a hip band. Built for people who walk for a living.

delver_frame.name: Delver's Frame
delver_frame.desc: A load-bearing frame built for hauling corpses out.

corpse_sledge.name: Corpse Sledge
corpse_sledge.desc: Two runners and a harness. You are the animal.

haulers_delver_frame.name: Hauler's Delver's Frame

recipe.note: fails 10% of the time: ink and fee lost, item kept (design/06 8.5)

haulers_delver_frame.desc: The straps are written on. The load is not lighter; you mind it less.

rope_belt.name: Rope Belt
rope_belt.desc: Holds your trousers up. One day it will hold one thing besides.

tool_belt.name: Tool Belt
tool_belt.desc: Loops for things you want without looking.

quiver_belt.name: Quiver Belt
quiver_belt.desc: The next one is always where your hand already is.

delvers_harness.name: Delver's Harness
delvers_harness.desc: Belt, braces and more rings than anyone has found a use for.

lifting_belt.name: Lifting Belt
lifting_belt.desc: Four inches of hide round the middle. Plate sits easier over it.

guttering_mote.name: Guttering Mote
guttering_mote.desc: Half a satellite, on a good day. Somebody dropped it.

dim_mote.name: Dim Mote
dim_mote.desc: A one-star satellite. It trickles essence into you whether you ask or not.

paired_mote.name: Paired Mote
paired_mote.desc: A two-star satellite. Rank does not matter to the wearer - only the price does.

trine_mote.name: Trine Mote
trine_mote.desc: A three-star satellite. Whoever lost this is looking for it.

fevered_mote.name: Fevered Mote
fevered_mote.effect_text: A two-star flow at a one-star price.
fevered_mote.desc: Two stars of flow, and it runs hot. Cheap for a reason.

river_stone.name: River Stone Charm
river_stone.desc: Water abilities cost a tenth less essence.

hearth_coal_charm.name: Hearth Coal Charm
hearth_coal_charm.desc: A coal that never quite went out. Fire abilities cost a tenth less essence.

plumb_weight_charm.name: Plumb Weight Charm
plumb_weight_charm.desc: A mason's lead on a string. Earth abilities cost a tenth less essence.

kite_bone_charm.name: Kite Bone Charm
kite_bone_charm.desc: Hollow, and it whistles. Wind abilities cost a tenth less essence.

fulgurite_charm.name: Fulgurite Charm
fulgurite_charm.desc: Sand that was struck once. Lightning abilities cost a tenth less essence.

brine_phial.name: Brine Phial
brine_phial.desc: Sea water from somewhere deep. Water abilities hit a little harder.

tinder_knot.name: Tinder Knot
tinder_knot.desc: Char cloth, tied tight. Fire abilities hit a little harder.

keystone_chip.name: Keystone Chip
keystone_chip.desc: From an arch that is still standing without it. Earth abilities hit a little harder.

reed_whistle.name: Reed Whistle
reed_whistle.desc: One note. Wind abilities hit a little harder.

split_nail.name: Split Nail
split_nail.desc: Out of a barn door, after the storm. Lightning abilities hit a little harder.

cooling_coil.name: Cooling Coil
cooling_coil.desc: Reflux bleeds off a little faster. A little is what you can afford.

hauliers_knot.name: Haulier's Knot
hauliers_knot.desc: A knot that does not slip. You carry a little more than you should.

ballast_coin.name: Ballast Coin
ballast_coin.desc: Too heavy for what it buys. Kept low in a pocket, it helps.

tether_knot.name: Tether Knot
tether_knot.desc: Tie it round the wrist before you sit. The soul strays a little further.

wisp_lure.name: Wisp Lure
wisp_lure.desc: A bead of something wisps like. They drift toward the projection's hand.

menders_thread.name: Mender's Thread
menders_thread.desc: Wound round the wrist. Healing spent on a lasting wound goes a tenth further.

yard_token.name: Yard Token
yard_token.desc: A brass tag from a tempering yard. Sessions take a tenth less out of you.

paper_effigy.name: Paper Effigy
paper_effigy.desc: A folded figure. In the Netherecho it takes the first of what was meant for you.

pawned_ring.name: Pawned Ring
pawned_ring.desc: Somebody else's promise. It makes everything cheaper, and it is not yours.

moth_lamp.name: Moth Lamp
moth_lamp.effect_text: Wisps of affinities you do not hold can be gathered as plain ether.
moth_lamp.desc: Unlit, it does nothing. In the Netherecho every wisp comes to it.

marrow_spike.name: Marrow Spike
marrow_spike.effect_text: Each base strike costs 1 health and hits 25% harder (grows to 45%). The health is paid even on a miss.

grows.condition: your own health spent through it

marrow_spike.desc: A sliver of something's thighbone. It asks a little of yours.

long_refusal.name: Long Refusal
long_refusal.effect_text: The guard never breaks: damage past the pool becomes reflux on your hottest affinity (1 per 2 damage) instead of reaching your health. If that affinity locks, the guard drops for 8 s.
long_refusal.desc: A shield that will not be told. What it cannot hold, it hands to you another way.

dead_mans_lung.name: Dead Man's Lung
dead_mans_lung.effect_text: With no reflux to vent it still fires, at 2 health a shot.

grows.condition: kills made with a dry shot

dead_mans_lung.desc: A flue with one breath of its own left in it, every time.

quiet_mote.name: Quiet Mote

grows.condition: passages cleared in full without sitting to meditate

quiet_mote.desc: A one-star satellite that leaves nothing behind. Nobody can say where the residue goes.

borrowed_face.name: Borrowed Face
borrowed_face.effect_text: In the Netherecho, docile constructs never turn on you; hostile ones notice you from half as far.
borrowed_face.desc: A plain mask with no expression. Constructs look at it and see nothing to object to.

stitchwork_coat.name: Stitchwork Coat
stitchwork_coat.effect_text: +3 armour for each lasting wound you are carrying (up to 4 wounds; grows to 6).

grows.condition: lasting wounds mended without a healer

stitchwork_coat.desc: Every tear has been sewn shut with a different thread. It keeps count for you.

creditors_ring.name: Creditor's Ring
creditors_ring.effect_text: While your money is below zero: strikes and abilities hit 10% harder and abilities cost 10% less. While solvent: nothing.
creditors_ring.desc: Worn by people who are owed. It only works for people who owe.

undertakers_ledger.name: Undertaker's Ledger
undertakers_ledger.effect_text: Damage past what a kill needed is banked (up to 100) and added to your next base strike.
undertakers_ledger.desc: A small black book. Whatever was left over is written down, and carried forward.

arrow_bundle.name: Bundle of Arrows
arrow_bundle.desc: Twenty, tied with cord. About half come back.

barbed_arrows.name: Barbed Arrows
barbed_arrows.desc: Twelve. They do not come out the way they went in, so they do not come back.

bolt_case.name: Case of Bolts
bolt_case.desc: Twelve short, heavy bolts. Most can be dug out.

lead_shot.name: Pouch of Lead Shot
lead_shot.desc: Thirty cast bullets. A sling throws them a quarter harder than gravel. They are gone once thrown.

field_dressing.name: Field Dressing
field_dressing.desc: Clean linen and a pin. Out of a fight: stops bleeding and returns 15 health over 8 seconds. Ordinary first aid; the star does not mind.

cooling_paste.name: Cooling Paste
cooling_paste.desc: Grey, cold, smells of pennies. Takes 30 reflux off your hottest affinity. The delve teaches you a little less for it.

bitter_draught.name: Bitter Draught
bitter_draught.desc: Thirty essence, now. It leaves 15 reflux on every affinity, and the delve teaches you a little less.

numbing_salt.name: Numbing Salt
numbing_salt.desc: For 60 seconds your wounds cost you nothing. Then each one is a tenth deeper, and the delve teaches you a little less.

husk_plate.name: Husk Plate
husk_plate.desc: A slab of invader hide. Tanners buy it.

sinew_cord.name: Sinew Cord
sinew_cord.desc: Tough, stringy, sells by the length.

brute_tusk.name: Brute Tusk
brute_tusk.desc: Heavy. Worth it if you can still walk.

commander_sigil.name: Commander's Sigil
commander_sigil.desc: Proof you put one down. Collectors pay.

golden_seed.name: Golden Grass Seed
golden_seed.desc: Passage flora. The rich plant it to show off.

cracked_mask.name: Cracked Mask
cracked_mask.desc: A skirmisher's face. Children's parties, mostly.

pavise_boss.name: Pavise Boss
pavise_boss.desc: The iron boss from a body-length shield. Smiths buy the metal.

fletching_bundle.name: Bundle of Fletchings
fletching_bundle.desc: Feathers off a bird nobody here has seen. Fletchers want them.

harrier_claw.name: Harrier Hook-Claw
harrier_claw.desc: Curved, hollow, sharp on the inside edge. Sold as a letter opener.

censer_chain.name: Censer Chain
censer_chain.desc: Blackened links that still smell of the smoke.

drum_skin.name: Drum Skin
drum_skin.desc: Nobody asks what it was the skin of.

wall_banner.name: Wall Banner
wall_banner.desc: A commander's colours, with holes. Looks well above a fireplace.

slate_fern_root.name: Slate Fern Root
slate_fern_root.desc: Passage flora. Apothecaries grind it; do not ask them for what.

grey_lichen.name: Grey Lichen
grey_lichen.desc: Scraped off a chamber wall. Dyers pay by the handful.

blood_soaked_mask.name: Blood-Soaked Mask
blood_soaked_mask.desc: A mask from the middle of a slaughter. Carry it while you project: a construct is more likely to be waiting.

slaughter_stone.name: Slaughter-Stone
slaughter_stone.desc: A floor stone that drank a whole wall's worth. Carry it while you project: what waits is more likely to be a remnant.

steel_billet.name: Steel Billet
steel_billet.desc: A clean bar. A smith can do something with this.

cured_hide.name: Cured Hide
cured_hide.desc: Husk plate after somebody patient has been at it.

heartwood_stave.name: Heartwood Stave
heartwood_stave.desc: Straight grain, no knots. Bows and hafts.

binding_wire.name: Binding Wire
binding_wire.desc: Soft iron wire. Holds grips, rims and tempers together.

flux_salt.name: Flux Salt
flux_salt.desc: Burns white. Smiths and runesetters both use it and neither says for what.

censer_ash.name: Censer Ash
censer_ash.desc: A pouch of what was burning. Apothecaries argue over what it is good for.

blank_slate.name: Blank Slate
blank_slate.desc: Split thin and polished. Runes are practised here before they go anywhere that matters.

rune_ink.name: Rune Ink
rune_ink.desc: Enough to write one rune onto one thing. The runesetter does not give refunds.

scroll_undertow.name: Scroll: Undertow
scroll_undertow.desc: Teaches Undertow to someone with the water affinity. Read once; the scroll is used up. Click it in your pack to read it.

scroll_riptide_lash.name: Scroll: Riptide Lash
scroll_riptide_lash.desc: Teaches Riptide Lash to someone with the water affinity. Read once; the scroll is used up. Click it in your pack to read it.

scroll_backdraft.name: Scroll: Backdraft
scroll_backdraft.desc: Teaches Backdraft to someone with the fire affinity. Read once; the scroll is used up. Click it in your pack to read it.

scroll_pyre_call.name: Scroll: Pyre Call
scroll_pyre_call.desc: Teaches Pyre Call to someone with the fire affinity. Read once; the scroll is used up. Click it in your pack to read it.

scroll_pillar.name: Scroll: Pillar
scroll_pillar.desc: Teaches Pillar to someone with the earth affinity. Read once; the scroll is used up. Click it in your pack to read it.

scroll_tremor.name: Scroll: Tremor
scroll_tremor.desc: Teaches Tremor to someone with the earth affinity. Read once; the scroll is used up. Click it in your pack to read it.

scroll_downdraft.name: Scroll: Downdraft
scroll_downdraft.desc: Teaches Downdraft to someone with the wind affinity. Read once; the scroll is used up. Click it in your pack to read it.

scroll_updraft.name: Scroll: Updraft
scroll_updraft.desc: Teaches Updraft to someone with the wind affinity. Read once; the scroll is used up. Click it in your pack to read it.

scroll_forked_path.name: Scroll: Forked Path
scroll_forked_path.desc: Teaches Forked Path to someone with the lightning affinity. Read once; the scroll is used up. Click it in your pack to read it.

scroll_dead_short.name: Scroll: Dead Short
scroll_dead_short.desc: Teaches Dead Short to someone with the lightning affinity. Read once; the scroll is used up. Click it in your pack to read it.

scroll_standing_pool.name: Scroll: Standing Pool
scroll_standing_pool.desc: Teaches Standing Pool to someone with the water affinity. Read once; the scroll is used up. Click it in your pack to read it.

scroll_backwash.name: Scroll: Backwash
scroll_backwash.desc: Teaches Backwash to someone with the water affinity. Read once; the scroll is used up. Click it in your pack to read it.

scroll_slag_pool.name: Scroll: Slag Pool
scroll_slag_pool.desc: Teaches Slag Pool to someone with the fire affinity. Read once; the scroll is used up. Click it in your pack to read it.

scroll_stoke.name: Scroll: Stoke
scroll_stoke.desc: Teaches Stoke to someone with the fire affinity. Read once; the scroll is used up. Click it in your pack to read it.

scroll_stonehide.name: Scroll: Stonehide
scroll_stonehide.desc: Teaches Stonehide to someone with the earth affinity. Read once; the scroll is used up. Click it in your pack to read it.

scroll_veil.name: Scroll: Crosswind Veil
scroll_veil.desc: Teaches Crosswind Veil to someone with the wind affinity. Read once; the scroll is used up. Click it in your pack to read it.

scroll_gale_lane.name: Scroll: Gale Lane
scroll_gale_lane.desc: Teaches Gale Lane to someone with the wind affinity. Read once; the scroll is used up. Click it in your pack to read it.

scroll_static_coat.name: Scroll: Static Coat
scroll_static_coat.desc: Teaches Static Coat to someone with the lightning affinity. Read once; the scroll is used up. Click it in your pack to read it.

scroll_ground_rod.name: Scroll: Ground Rod
scroll_ground_rod.desc: Teaches Ground Rod to someone with the lightning affinity. Read once; the scroll is used up. Click it in your pack to read it.

scroll_bedrock_shove.name: Scroll: Bedrock Shove
scroll_bedrock_shove.desc: Teaches Bedrock Shove to someone with the earth affinity. Read once; the scroll is used up. Click it in your pack to read it.

skirmisher_mask.name: Skirmisher's Mask
skirmisher_mask.desc: A pale lacquered mask, still warm. Collectors and the curious pay for them.

rampart_bowstave.name: Rampart Bowstave
rampart_bowstave.desc: Seasoned wood under the grime. A bowyer will want it.

harrier_pelt.name: Harrier Pelt
harrier_pelt.desc: Short, coarse, and the colour of dusk. Furriers buy them.

brute_hide.name: Brute Hide
brute_hide.desc: A slab of hide as thick as a door. Worth a great deal to anyone who can carry it.

war_drumhead.name: War Drumhead
war_drumhead.desc: Stretched skin, painted. It still hums when you touch it.

spoils_strongbox.name: Sealed Strongbox
spoils_strongbox.desc: Passage spoils, locked and heavy. The counting-house in town opens it and pays.

spoils_relics.name: Case of Relics
spoils_relics.desc: Passage spoils: odd small things the passage gave up. They sell.

spoils_salvage.name: Passage Salvage
spoils_salvage.desc: Passage spoils: scrap worth having. It sells.

flax_bundle.name: Flax Bundle
flax_bundle.desc: Retted flax off the Stubble's one wet corner. Spun, it is linen.

linen_bolt.name: Linen Bolt
linen_bolt.desc: A bolt of plain linen. Padding, dressings, the inside of everything.

lockweed.name: Lockweed
lockweed.desc: Cut from the basin wall of the Drowned Lock, which grows it back every dawn. It knits flesh.

barrow_sloe.name: Barrow Sloe
barrow_sloe.desc: A sour sloe that grows only on passage mounds. The first fruit elixir makers learn on.

gleaner_hoard.name: Gleaner's Hoard
gleaner_hoard.desc: Whatever a Gleaner had picked up: buttons, nails, a tooth. Sold by the bag.

lurker_jaw.name: Sod-Lurker Jaw
lurker_jaw.desc: A jaw built to close upward. Bonesetters use the teeth as pegs.

thornback_hide.name: Thornback Hide
thornback_hide.desc: Most of a Thornback's back, spines and all. More than a starting pack holds.

thornback_horn.name: Thornback Horn
thornback_horn.desc: A grazer's horn, worn smooth on one side from rubbing on stones.

flecked_brinepearl.name: Flecked Brinepearl
flecked_brinepearl.desc: A fleck of water ether that pooled and set in thin ground. Charms and charges are made of it.

flecked_emberite.name: Flecked Emberite
flecked_emberite.desc: A fleck of fire ether that pooled and set in thin ground. Charms and charges are made of it.

flecked_loamstone.name: Flecked Loamstone
flecked_loamstone.desc: A fleck of earth ether that pooled and set in thin ground. Charms and charges are made of it.

flecked_galequill.name: Flecked Galequill
flecked_galequill.desc: A fleck of wind ether that pooled and set in thin ground. Charms and charges are made of it.

flecked_fulgurite.name: Flecked Fulgurite
flecked_fulgurite.desc: A fleck of lightning ether that pooled and set in thin ground. Charms and charges are made of it.

proof_old_hapenny.name: Old Ha'penny's Purse
proof_old_hapenny.desc: A purse of other people's coins, sewn shut. Proof he will not be back.

proof_widow_mask.name: The Widow-Mask
proof_widow_mask.desc: The mask of the one who came looking for you. The Collection Office pays for it, and asks no questions.

proof_dray.name: Dray's Harness Ring
proof_dray.desc: The iron ring Dray's sledge hung from. It took two hands to lift off him.

proof_long_sorrow.name: Long Sorrow's Collar
proof_long_sorrow.desc: A braided collar off the harrier that led the pack.

proof_wet_wick.name: Wet Wick's Snuffer
proof_wet_wick.desc: A snuffer on a chain. Everything it touched went dark.

proof_unseen_fletcher.name: The Unseen Fletcher's Nock
proof_unseen_fletcher.desc: A carved nock from the archer you never saw draw.

proof_auditor.name: The Auditor's Ledger
proof_auditor.desc: The ledger chained to the Auditor's arm. Every entry is a debt; one is yours.

proof_muster_captain.name: The Muster-Captain's Standard
proof_muster_captain.desc: A war-camp's standard. Proof the Muster is broken, for a while.

manual_hard_knit.name: Manual: Hard Knit
manual_hard_knit.desc: A tempering manual for anyone: Health returns faster between fights. Read once in the yard; the manual is used up.

manual_rooted_stance.name: Manual: Rooted Stance
manual_rooted_stance.desc: A tempering manual for anyone: Your own poise grows. Read once in the yard; the manual is used up.

manual_yielding_flesh.name: Manual: Yielding Flesh
manual_yielding_flesh.desc: A tempering manual for someone with the water affinity: The first hit of each exchange lands soft. Read once in the yard; the manual is used up.

manual_brine_blood.name: Manual: Brine Blood
manual_brine_blood.desc: A tempering manual for someone with the water affinity: Lingering harm on you ends sooner. Read once in the yard; the manual is used up.

manual_banked_coals.name: Manual: Banked Coals
manual_banked_coals.desc: A tempering manual for someone with the fire affinity: Reflux pain starts later. Read once in the yard; the manual is used up.

manual_seared_shut.name: Manual: Seared Shut
manual_seared_shut.desc: A tempering manual for someone with the fire affinity: Some wounds never open. Read once in the yard; the manual is used up.

manual_ballast.name: Manual: Ballast
manual_ballast.desc: A tempering manual for someone with the earth affinity: You are shoved less far and stagger shorter. Read once in the yard; the manual is used up.

manual_settled_weight.name: Manual: Settled Weight
manual_settled_weight.desc: A tempering manual for someone with the earth affinity: Standing still, you take less. Read once in the yard; the manual is used up.

manual_loose_joints.name: Manual: Loose Joints
manual_loose_joints.desc: A tempering manual for someone with the wind affinity: You recover sooner out of a dash. Read once in the yard; the manual is used up.

manual_glancing_skin.name: Manual: Glancing Skin
manual_glancing_skin.desc: A tempering manual for someone with the wind affinity: Shots on the run barely bite. Read once in the yard; the manual is used up.

manual_jolt_reflex.name: Manual: Jolt Reflex
manual_jolt_reflex.desc: A tempering manual for someone with the lightning affinity: Getting hit throws you clear. Read once in the yard; the manual is used up.

manual_scorched_channels.name: Manual: Scorched Channels
manual_scorched_channels.desc: A tempering manual for someone with the lightning affinity: Lock-outs are shorter. Read once in the yard; the manual is used up.

key_counting_house_vault.name: Counting-House Vault Key
key_counting_house_vault.desc: A key off the Auditor's chain. It opens the vault chest at the bottom of the Old Counting-House, once.

key_drowned_lock_wheel.name: Sluice-Wheel Handle
key_drowned_lock_wheel.desc: Fits the sluice in the Drowned Lock. Turning it drains the basin for a while; nobody knows what else it does.

key_muster_pass.name: Muster Pass
key_muster_pass.desc: A camp pass, cut from a dead sentry's belt. The gate guards of the Muster look at it a moment longer.

quest_registry_papers.name: Registry Papers
quest_registry_papers.desc: Your papers as an archhuman, stamped in Passage Row. Losing them is a week in a queue.

quest_sealed_letter.name: Sealed Letter
quest_sealed_letter.desc: A letter you were paid to carry and not to open. Placeholder for courier work.

knitting_salve.name: Knitting Salve
knitting_salve.desc: Rubbed into your oldest lasting wound, it does 12 points of the healing that wound is waiting for. Slower than the bonesetter, and you can carry it.

regrowth_draught.name: Regrowth Draught
regrowth_draught.desc: Drunk in a safe place, it grows back a lost arm over the night. It itches for a week.

iron_tonic.name: Iron Tonic
iron_tonic.desc: An alchemist's strength tonic. Two minutes of strikes 10% harder, then two minutes of strikes a tenth weaker. The delve teaches you a little less.

yard_liniment.name: Yard Liniment
yard_liniment.desc: Rubbed in before a tempering session: the strain it leaves is smaller, and so is what you learn.

pale_tincture.name: Pale Tincture
pale_tincture.desc: An ascension aid. It pours blank growth into your newest star. The star fills; what it fills with is nobody in particular. Too many and the talent itself starts to wear.

bleeding_oil.name: Bleeding Oil
bleeding_oil.desc: Wiped on an edge: for 20 base strikes each hit opens one more bleeding stack.

lead_lacquer.name: Lead Lacquer
lead_lacquer.desc: A heavy lacquer for a weapon's head. For 20 base strikes they break poise half again as fast.

smoke_pot.name: Smoke Pot
smoke_pot.desc: Thrown: a bank of smoke three metres across. Nothing shoots through it.

tether_incense.name: Tether Incense
tether_incense.desc: Burned before you sit: your next projection strays 3 metres further from the body.

binding_salts.name: Binding Salts
binding_salts.desc: Scattered in a circle before a binding: the next binding of a construct is a little likelier to hold.

trail_ration.name: Trail Ration
trail_ration.desc: Hard bread, dried fruit and something salted. For an hour of the clock natural healing runs a quarter faster.

brine_charge.name: Brine Charge
brine_charge.desc: Your next three water skills shove 30% further. Only for someone with the water affinity. The delve teaches you a little less.

pitch_wick.name: Pitch Wick
pitch_wick.desc: For ten seconds your Heat counts as 20 reflux higher than it is, without the reflux. Only for someone with the fire affinity. The delve teaches you a little less.

masons_grit.name: Mason's Grit
masons_grit.desc: Your next two standing stones have 50% more life and stand half as long again. Only for someone with the earth affinity. The delve teaches you a little less.

gale_quill.name: Gale Quill
gale_quill.desc: 4 Slipstream pips at once. Only for someone with the wind affinity. The delve teaches you a little less.

charged_filament.name: Charged Filament
charged_filament.desc: Your next three lightning hits leave 2 marks instead of one. Only for someone with the lightning affinity. The delve teaches you a little less.

flecked_ether_sliver.name: Flecked Ether Sliver
flecked_ether_sliver.desc: A sliver of settled ether that burns in place of your stars: your next skill's essence cost, up to 12, is paid from it. Its reflux is still yours. The delve teaches you a little less.

bodkin_arrows.name: Bodkin Arrows
bodkin_arrows.desc: Twelve square-headed arrows for armour. Front armour and shields count half against them.

blunt_bolts.name: Blunt Bolts
blunt_bolts.desc: Twelve bolts with heavy blunt heads. They break poise, not skin, and nearly all come back.

reedback_hide.name: Reedback Hide
reedback_hide.desc: From a slow fen grazer with a back like a thatched roof. Tanners in Pilings pay well. Tanned, it is the band's leather.

ridge_ram_horn.name: Ridge Ram Horn
ridge_ram_horn.desc: A spiral of horn off a ram that butts climbers off the Hackle's ledges. A crafter's masterwork piece for bows, slings and coats.

spinner_silk_skein.name: Spinner Silk Skein
spinner_silk_skein.desc: Wound off a reed spinner's web before it could wake. Sticky for a day. Spun, it is the band's cloth.

effigy_ironwork.name: Toll-Effigy Ironwork
effigy_ironwork.desc: The iron bones of a made thing that stood at a crossing and demanded payment. A smith's masterwork piece; the metal is the band's own.

reeve_chain.name: Fen Reeve's Chain
reeve_chain.desc: A chain of office off a fen reeve. Someone in Pilings will want it back. Good only for selling, and very good for that.

gatesteel_ore.name: Gatesteel Ore
gatesteel_ore.desc: Ore of gatesteel, from veins and resource caches. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

bog_oak_log.name: Bog-Oak Log
bog_oak_log.desc: A length of bog-oak, felled and trimmed. Bog-oak, black from a century under the fen.

ether_salt_b2.name: Iron-Bound Ether Salt
ether_salt_b2.desc: Plain ether that pooled and crystallised in rich ground. Flux for smiths, base for alchemists, ink for runesetters.

fen_mallow.name: Fen Mallow
fen_mallow.desc: Fen Mallow. Pressed into a wound it pulls the edges toward each other. Apothecaries buy it by the bunch.

bitterbog.name: Bitterbog
bitterbog.desc: Bitterbog. Bitter enough to make an essence draught taste of something worse. The base of most draughts.

cold_sedge.name: Cold Sedge
cold_sedge.desc: Cold Sedge. Cold to hold in any weather. Alchemists use it to draw heat out of a paste.

tithe_plum.name: Tithe Plum
tithe_plum.desc: Tithe Plum. Grown in a resource cache that puts it back every reset. Elixir makers pay for it.

gatesteel_bar.name: Gatesteel Bar
gatesteel_bar.desc: A bar of gatesteel. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

gatesteel_wire.name: Gatesteel Wire
gatesteel_wire.desc: Drawn gatesteel wire. It holds grips, rims and rings together.

reedback_leather.name: Reedback Leather
reedback_leather.desc: Tanned and cut into working sides. Reedback hide from the fen, oiled against the wet.

bog_oak_stave.name: Bog-Oak Stave
bog_oak_stave.desc: Split, seasoned and straight. Bog-oak, black from a century under the fen.

fen_silk_bolt.name: Fen-Silk Bolt
fen_silk_bolt.desc: A bolt of woven cloth. Fen-silk from the spinners in the reeds; it sheds water and heat.

rune_ink_b2.name: Iron-Bound Rune Ink
rune_ink_b2.desc: Enough ink to write one rune onto one thing of this band. The runesetter does not give refunds.

gatesteel_knuckles.name: Gatesteel Knuckles
gatesteel_knuckles.desc: A pair of knuckle-bars for working hands. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

gatesteel_dusters.name: Gatesteel Dusters
gatesteel_dusters.desc: Dusters with a ridge for each knuckle, fitted close. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

gatesteel_knife.name: Gatesteel Knife
gatesteel_knife.desc: A plain knife, long enough to matter. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

gatesteel_dirk.name: Gatesteel Dirk
gatesteel_dirk.desc: A narrow dirk for finding the gap. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

gatesteel_blade.name: Gatesteel Blade
gatesteel_blade.desc: A one-handed sword, plain and honest. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

gatesteel_sword.name: Gatesteel Sword
gatesteel_sword.desc: A balanced sword made by someone who fought with one. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

gatesteel_axe.name: Gatesteel Axe
gatesteel_axe.desc: A one-handed axe. The cut keeps working after it lands. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

gatesteel_bearded_axe.name: Gatesteel Bearded Axe
gatesteel_bearded_axe.desc: A bearded axe, hooked for shields and ankles. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

gatesteel_mace.name: Gatesteel Mace
gatesteel_mace.desc: A flanged mace. It does not care which flange arrives. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

gatesteel_warhammer.name: Gatesteel Warhammer
gatesteel_warhammer.desc: A warhammer with a beak behind the face. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

gatesteel_spear.name: Gatesteel Spear
gatesteel_spear.desc: A spear: be further away than the other one. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

gatesteel_partisan.name: Gatesteel Partisan
gatesteel_partisan.desc: A partisan with a broad head and side lugs. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

gatesteel_maul.name: Gatesteel Maul
gatesteel_maul.desc: A two-handed maul. One swing, one decision. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

gatesteel_greatsword.name: Gatesteel Greatsword
gatesteel_greatsword.desc: A greatsword long enough to need its own plan. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

gatesteel_throwing_knives.name: Gatesteel Throwing Knives
gatesteel_throwing_knives.desc: A roll of six balanced throwing knives. Most come back. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

gatesteel_javelins.name: Gatesteel Javelins
gatesteel_javelins.desc: Three short javelins. Each goes through the first thing. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

fen_silk_sling.name: Fen-Silk Sling
fen_silk_sling.desc: A sling: a cord, a pouch and whatever is on the ground. Fen-silk from the spinners in the reeds; it sheds water and heat.

reedback_staff_sling.name: Reedback Staff Sling
reedback_staff_sling.desc: A staff sling for throwing over walls. Reedback hide from the fen, oiled against the wet.

bog_oak_bow.name: Bog-Oak Bow
bog_oak_bow.desc: A hunting bow with a long, easy draw. Bog-oak, black from a century under the fen.

bog_oak_recurve.name: Bog-Oak Recurve
bog_oak_recurve.desc: A recurve that holds its draw. Bog-oak, black from a century under the fen.

bog_oak_crossbow.name: Bog-Oak Crossbow
bog_oak_crossbow.desc: A lever crossbow. It does not care how many stars you have. Bog-oak, black from a century under the fen.

bog_oak_arbalest.name: Bog-Oak Arbalest
bog_oak_arbalest.desc: An arbalest with a crank. One very final noise. Bog-oak, black from a century under the fen.

gatesteel_flue.name: Gatesteel Flue
gatesteel_flue.desc: A runed pipe that coughs your own reflux out as shot. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

gatesteel_long_flue.name: Gatesteel Long Flue
gatesteel_long_flue.desc: A long flue with tight seams; less of the heat comes back up your arm. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

gatesteel_buckler.name: Gatesteel Buckler
gatesteel_buckler.desc: A small round buckler, back in place before the next blow. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

bog_oak_shield.name: Bog-Oak Shield
bog_oak_shield.desc: A round shield of planks with a boss. Bog-oak, black from a century under the fen.

gatesteel_heater_shield.name: Gatesteel Heater Shield
gatesteel_heater_shield.desc: A heater shield, rimmed and faced. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

gatesteel_sump.name: Gatesteel Sump
gatesteel_sump.desc: A stoppered sump: some of what your casting leaves settles in it instead of you. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

gatesteel_tablet.name: Gatesteel Tablet
gatesteel_tablet.desc: A focus tablet with a working written on it. Fewer mistakes, less waste. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

fen_silk_hood.name: Fen-Silk Hood
fen_silk_hood.desc: A hood that sheds rain and a little heat. Fen-silk from the spinners in the reeds; it sheds water and heat.

fen_silk_jack.name: Fen-Silk Jack
fen_silk_jack.desc: A quilted jack. It breathes, which matters more than you think. Fen-silk from the spinners in the reeds; it sheds water and heat.

fen_silk_gloves.name: Fen-Silk Gloves
fen_silk_gloves.desc: Soft gloves; you can feel the grip. Fen-silk from the spinners in the reeds; it sheds water and heat.

fen_silk_runners.name: Fen-Silk Runners
fen_silk_runners.desc: Soft runners with no heel and no noise. Fen-silk from the spinners in the reeds; it sheds water and heat.

fen_silk_long_coat.name: Fen-Silk Long Coat
fen_silk_long_coat.desc: A long coat, waxed, vented and mostly pockets. Fen-silk from the spinners in the reeds; it sheds water and heat.

reedback_cap.name: Reedback Cap
reedback_cap.desc: A boiled cap, cooked until it gave up being skin. Reedback hide from the fen, oiled against the wet.

reedback_cuirass.name: Reedback Cuirass
reedback_cuirass.desc: A cuirass of boiled leather, stiff as a door for the first month. Reedback hide from the fen, oiled against the wet.

reedback_bracers.name: Reedback Bracers
reedback_bracers.desc: Bracers between an edge and the arm you need. Reedback hide from the fen, oiled against the wet.

reedback_boots.name: Reedback Boots
reedback_boots.desc: Hobnailed boots. You stay where you stood. Reedback hide from the fen, oiled against the wet.

reedback_brigandine.name: Reedback Brigandine
reedback_brigandine.desc: A brigandine: plates riveted inside a leather coat. Reedback hide from the fen, oiled against the wet.

gatesteel_helm.name: Gatesteel Helm
gatesteel_helm.desc: A helm with a brim for things falling off walls. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

gatesteel_plate.name: Gatesteel Plate
gatesteel_plate.desc: Plate front and back. The heat has nowhere to go, and neither do you. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

gatesteel_gauntlets.name: Gatesteel Gauntlets
gatesteel_gauntlets.desc: Gauntlets with no fingers to lose track of. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

gatesteel_sabatons.name: Gatesteel Sabatons
gatesteel_sabatons.desc: Sabatons. Stairs become a negotiation. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

gatesteel_harness.name: Gatesteel Harness
gatesteel_harness.desc: A full harness, measured for you. Gatesteel is passage scrap, smelted honestly.

reedback_frame.name: Reedback Frame
reedback_frame.desc: A load-bearing frame for hauling corpses out. Reedback hide from the fen, oiled against the wet.

reedback_belt.name: Reedback Belt
reedback_belt.desc: A belt with loops for what you want without looking. Reedback hide from the fen, oiled against the wet.

gatesteel_tide_charm.name: Gatesteel Tide Charm
gatesteel_tide_charm.desc: A charm set with brinepearl in gatesteel. Water abilities cost less essence.

gatesteel_tide_talisman.name: Gatesteel Tide Talisman
gatesteel_tide_talisman.desc: A talisman of brinepearl bound in gatesteel wire. Water abilities hit a little harder.

gatesteel_ember_charm.name: Gatesteel Ember Charm
gatesteel_ember_charm.desc: A charm set with emberite in gatesteel. Fire abilities cost less essence.

gatesteel_ember_talisman.name: Gatesteel Ember Talisman
gatesteel_ember_talisman.desc: A talisman of emberite bound in gatesteel wire. Fire abilities hit a little harder.

gatesteel_loam_charm.name: Gatesteel Loam Charm
gatesteel_loam_charm.desc: A charm set with loamstone in gatesteel. Earth abilities cost less essence.

gatesteel_loam_talisman.name: Gatesteel Loam Talisman
gatesteel_loam_talisman.desc: A talisman of loamstone bound in gatesteel wire. Earth abilities hit a little harder.

gatesteel_gale_charm.name: Gatesteel Gale Charm
gatesteel_gale_charm.desc: A charm set with galequill in gatesteel. Wind abilities cost less essence.

gatesteel_gale_talisman.name: Gatesteel Gale Talisman
gatesteel_gale_talisman.desc: A talisman of galequill bound in gatesteel wire. Wind abilities hit a little harder.

gatesteel_storm_charm.name: Gatesteel Storm Charm
gatesteel_storm_charm.desc: A charm set with fulgurite in gatesteel. Lightning abilities cost less essence.

gatesteel_storm_talisman.name: Gatesteel Storm Talisman
gatesteel_storm_talisman.desc: A talisman of fulgurite bound in gatesteel wire. Lightning abilities hit a little harder.

gatesteel_cooling_coil.name: Gatesteel Cooling Coil
gatesteel_cooling_coil.desc: A coil of gatesteel that runs cold when you run hot. Reflux bleeds off a little faster.

fen_silk_menders_thread.name: Fen-Silk Mender's Thread
fen_silk_menders_thread.desc: A thread of fen-silk soaked in fen mallow, wound round the wrist. Healing spent on a lasting wound goes further.

fen_mallow_poultice.name: Fen Mallow Poultice
fen_mallow_poultice.desc: Fen Mallow bound in cloth. Out of a fight it returns a fifth of your health over ten seconds and speeds natural healing for five minutes. Ordinary medicine; the star does not mind.

fen_mallow_salve.name: Fen Mallow Salve
fen_mallow_salve.desc: Rubbed into your oldest lasting wound, it does 16 points of the healing that wound is waiting for. Slower than the bonesetter, and you can carry it.

iron_bound_clotting_powder.name: Iron-Bound Clotting Powder
iron_bound_clotting_powder.desc: Thrown into a wound mid-fight: bleeding stops, and the next wound you take is a quarter shallower.

bitterbog_draught.name: Bitterbog Draught
bitterbog_draught.desc: 60 essence, now. It leaves 15 reflux on every affinity, and the delve teaches you a little less.

cold_sedge_paste.name: Cold Sedge Paste
cold_sedge_paste.desc: Cold, grey and smelling of pennies. Takes 33 reflux off your hottest affinity. The delve teaches you a little less for it.

iron_bound_steadying_tonic.name: Iron-Bound Steadying Tonic
iron_bound_steadying_tonic.desc: Two minutes of steadier feet (more poise), then a minute of wobbling. The delve teaches you a little less.

iron_bound_yard_liniment.name: Iron-Bound Yard Liniment
iron_bound_yard_liniment.desc: Rubbed in before a tempering session: the strain it leaves is smaller, and so is what you learn.

iron_bound_pale_tincture.name: Iron-Bound Pale Tincture
iron_bound_pale_tincture.desc: An ascension aid. It pours blank growth into your newest star. The star fills; what it fills with is nobody in particular. Too many and the talent itself starts to wear.

iron_bound_blank_draught.name: Iron-Bound Blank Draught
iron_bound_blank_draught.desc: A soul elixir from a clinic. It patches soul damage with blank tissue. For small cracks, nobody notices; for big ones, slowly, you become someone else.

iron_bound_sap_venom.name: Iron-Bound Sap Venom
iron_bound_sap_venom.desc: For 15 base strikes each hit poisons for 8.2 a second over five seconds. Poison you laid pays your talent like any other harm.

iron_bound_caltrops.name: Iron-Bound Caltrops
iron_bound_caltrops.desc: Thrown: a spray of spikes. Anything walking through them goes four-tenths slower.

iron_bound_second_skin_wax.name: Iron-Bound Second-Skin Wax
iron_bound_second_skin_wax.desc: Rubbed on the temples: your next projection has 3 more life.

gatesteel_tipped_arrows.name: Gatesteel-Tipped Arrows
gatesteel_tipped_arrows.desc: Twenty arrows with gatesteel heads. About half come back.

gatesteel_bolts.name: Gatesteel Bolts
gatesteel_bolts.desc: Twelve short bolts, gatesteel to the shoulder. Most can be dug out.

gatesteel_shot.name: Gatesteel Shot
gatesteel_shot.desc: Thirty cast gatesteel bullets for a sling. Gone once thrown.

spoils_strongbox_b2.name: Iron-Bound Strongbox
spoils_strongbox_b2.desc: Passage spoils, locked and heavy. The counting-house in town opens it and pays.

spoils_relics_b2.name: Iron-Bound Relic Case
spoils_relics_b2.desc: Passage spoils: odd small things the passage gave up. They sell.

spoils_salvage_b2.name: Iron-Bound Salvage
spoils_salvage_b2.desc: Passage spoils: scrap worth having. It sells.

reeking_standard.name: Reeking Standard
reeking_standard.desc: Soaked through at the middle of a slaughter. Carry it while you project: what waits is more likely to be a remnant.

key_writ_b2.name: Iron-Bound Passage Writ
key_writ_b2.desc: Placeholder: the entry writ for an owned passage rated for 2 stars. Bought at that region's ticket hall.

whiteback_pelt.name: Whiteback Pelt
whiteback_pelt.desc: A snow bear's pelt, heavy as a wet sail. Worth the walk if you can make it. Tanned, it is the band's leather.

glass_elk_antler.name: Glass Elk Antler
glass_elk_antler.desc: Clear as ice and nearly as cold. Carvers and alchemists both bid. A crafter's masterwork piece for bows, slings and coats.

rime_floss_tuft.name: Rime Floss Tuft
rime_floss_tuft.desc: The winter down of something that nests in drifts. Weighs nothing. Spun, it is the band's cloth.

warden_rivets.name: Cairn Warden Rivets
warden_rivets.desc: Rivets out of a stone guardian's joints. The stone stayed; the metal came. A smith's masterwork piece; the metal is the band's own.

marshal_brand.name: Gate Marshal's Brand
marshal_brand.desc: A branding iron carried by the thing that held the gate. Still warm. Good only for selling, and very good for that.

steeped_steel_ore.name: Steeped Steel Ore
steeped_steel_ore.desc: Ore of steeped steel, from veins and resource caches. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

rimepine_log.name: Rimepine Log
rimepine_log.desc: A length of rimepine, felled and trimmed. Rimepine, straight and light, cut where it never thaws.

ether_salt_b3.name: Steeped Ether Salt
ether_salt_b3.desc: Plain ether that pooled and crystallised in rich ground. Flux for smiths, base for alchemists, ink for runesetters.

snowknit.name: Snowknit
snowknit.desc: Snowknit. Pressed into a wound it pulls the edges toward each other. Apothecaries buy it by the bunch.

glass_thistle.name: Glass Thistle
glass_thistle.desc: Glass Thistle. Bitter enough to make an essence draught taste of something worse. The base of most draughts.

frostcap.name: Frostcap
frostcap.desc: Frostcap. Cold to hold in any weather. Alchemists use it to draw heat out of a paste.

ice_quince.name: Ice Quince
ice_quince.desc: Ice Quince. Grown in a resource cache that puts it back every reset. Elixir makers pay for it.

steeped_steel_bar.name: Steeped Steel Bar
steeped_steel_bar.desc: A bar of steeped steel. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

steeped_steel_wire.name: Steeped Steel Wire
steeped_steel_wire.desc: Drawn steeped steel wire. It holds grips, rims and rings together.

whiteback_leather.name: Whiteback Leather
whiteback_leather.desc: Tanned and cut into working sides. Whiteback pelt, shaved and boiled; it still smells of snow.

rimepine_stave.name: Rimepine Stave
rimepine_stave.desc: Split, seasoned and straight. Rimepine, straight and light, cut where it never thaws.

rime_floss_bolt.name: Rime-Floss Bolt
rime_floss_bolt.desc: A bolt of woven cloth. Rime-floss is warm and lighter than it has any right to be.

rune_ink_b3.name: Steeped Rune Ink
rune_ink_b3.desc: Enough ink to write one rune onto one thing of this band. The runesetter does not give refunds.

clouded_brinepearl.name: Clouded Brinepearl
clouded_brinepearl.desc: Water ether that pooled and set in rich ground, clouded all the way through. Charms, talismans and charges are made of it.

clouded_emberite.name: Clouded Emberite
clouded_emberite.desc: Fire ether that pooled and set in rich ground, clouded all the way through. Charms, talismans and charges are made of it.

clouded_loamstone.name: Clouded Loamstone
clouded_loamstone.desc: Earth ether that pooled and set in rich ground, clouded all the way through. Charms, talismans and charges are made of it.

clouded_galequill.name: Clouded Galequill
clouded_galequill.desc: Wind ether that pooled and set in rich ground, clouded all the way through. Charms, talismans and charges are made of it.

clouded_fulgurite.name: Clouded Fulgurite
clouded_fulgurite.desc: Lightning ether that pooled and set in rich ground, clouded all the way through. Charms, talismans and charges are made of it.

steeped_steel_knuckles.name: Steeped Steel Knuckles
steeped_steel_knuckles.desc: Your fists, with an argument added. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

steeped_steel_dusters.name: Steeped Steel Dusters
steeped_steel_dusters.desc: Close-fitted dusters, every edge filed to your grip. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

steeped_steel_knife.name: Steeped Steel Knife
steeped_steel_knife.desc: A working knife. Most of what it meets is softer than it. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

steeped_steel_dirk.name: Steeped Steel Dirk
steeped_steel_dirk.desc: A dirk ground thin enough to slip between plates. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

steeped_steel_blade.name: Steeped Steel Blade
steeped_steel_blade.desc: An issue sword: stamped, numbered, dependable. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

steeped_steel_sword.name: Steeped Steel Sword
steeped_steel_sword.desc: A long one-handed sword with a quiet edge. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

steeped_steel_axe.name: Steeped Steel Axe
steeped_steel_axe.desc: A hatchet grown up. It opens what it hits. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

steeped_steel_bearded_axe.name: Steeped Steel Bearded Axe
steeped_steel_bearded_axe.desc: A broad bearded head on a short haft. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

steeped_steel_mace.name: Steeped Steel Mace
steeped_steel_mace.desc: A mace for things wearing more than you are. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

steeped_steel_warhammer.name: Steeped Steel Warhammer
steeped_steel_warhammer.desc: A short warhammer, weighted forward. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

steeped_steel_spear.name: Steeped Steel Spear
steeped_steel_spear.desc: A plain spear on a long haft. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

steeped_steel_partisan.name: Steeped Steel Partisan
steeped_steel_partisan.desc: A partisan built to hold a doorway. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

steeped_steel_maul.name: Steeped Steel Maul
steeped_steel_maul.desc: A great maul: both hands, all of your attention. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

steeped_steel_greatsword.name: Steeped Steel Greatsword
steeped_steel_greatsword.desc: A two-handed blade with a ricasso to choke up on. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

steeped_steel_throwing_knives.name: Steeped Steel Throwing Knives
steeped_steel_throwing_knives.desc: Throwing knives in a bandolier, weighted at the tip. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

steeped_steel_javelins.name: Steeped Steel Javelins
steeped_steel_javelins.desc: A quiver of javelins with long iron shanks. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

rime_floss_sling.name: Rime-Floss Sling
rime_floss_sling.desc: A braided sling that never runs out of stones. Rime-floss is warm and lighter than it has any right to be.

whiteback_staff_sling.name: Whiteback Staff Sling
whiteback_staff_sling.desc: A sling on a pole; it throws a stone the size of a fist. Whiteback pelt, shaved and boiled; it still smells of snow.

rimepine_bow.name: Rimepine Bow
rimepine_bow.desc: A plain self bow. Stand still and it pays. Rimepine, straight and light, cut where it never thaws.

rimepine_recurve.name: Rimepine Recurve
rimepine_recurve.desc: A war recurve, short enough to turn with. Rimepine, straight and light, cut where it never thaws.

rimepine_crossbow.name: Rimepine Crossbow
rimepine_crossbow.desc: A crossbow spanned by a lever, one bolt at a time. Rimepine, straight and light, cut where it never thaws.

rimepine_arbalest.name: Rimepine Arbalest
rimepine_arbalest.desc: A heavy arbalest; the windlass hangs at the hip. Rimepine, straight and light, cut where it never thaws.

steeped_steel_flue.name: Steeped Steel Flue
steeped_steel_flue.desc: A plain flue: you cast, it vents, something falls over. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

steeped_steel_long_flue.name: Steeped Steel Long Flue
steeped_steel_long_flue.desc: A long-barrelled flue, runed along every seam. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

steeped_steel_buckler.name: Steeped Steel Buckler
steeped_steel_buckler.desc: A fist-sized boss with a rim. Quick, not deep. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

rimepine_shield.name: Rimepine Shield
rimepine_shield.desc: A plain shield. It takes what it is given. Rimepine, straight and light, cut where it never thaws.

steeped_steel_heater_shield.name: Steeped Steel Heater Shield
steeped_steel_heater_shield.desc: A banded heater shield with a fitted grip. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

steeped_steel_sump.name: Steeped Steel Sump
steeped_steel_sump.desc: A squat sump-jar. It hums when it is full. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

steeped_steel_tablet.name: Steeped Steel Tablet
steeped_steel_tablet.desc: A runed tablet: someone else's working, and theirs was better. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

rime_floss_hood.name: Rime-Floss Hood
rime_floss_hood.desc: A close hood; it breathes. Rime-floss is warm and lighter than it has any right to be.

rime_floss_jack.name: Rime-Floss Jack
rime_floss_jack.desc: A padded jack, quilted in diamonds. Rime-floss is warm and lighter than it has any right to be.

rime_floss_gloves.name: Rime-Floss Gloves
rime_floss_gloves.desc: Thin gloves, close at the wrist. Rime-floss is warm and lighter than it has any right to be.

rime_floss_runners.name: Rime-Floss Runners
rime_floss_runners.desc: Light shoes for people who are paid to arrive. Rime-floss is warm and lighter than it has any right to be.

rime_floss_long_coat.name: Rime-Floss Long Coat
rime_floss_long_coat.desc: A delving coat cut long, with a hood rolled at the collar. Rime-floss is warm and lighter than it has any right to be.

whiteback_cap.name: Whiteback Cap
whiteback_cap.desc: A stiff cap with a brow-band. Whiteback pelt, shaved and boiled; it still smells of snow.

whiteback_cuirass.name: Whiteback Cuirass
whiteback_cuirass.desc: A moulded leather cuirass laced at the side. Whiteback pelt, shaved and boiled; it still smells of snow.

whiteback_bracers.name: Whiteback Bracers
whiteback_bracers.desc: Laced bracers with a rib down the forearm. Whiteback pelt, shaved and boiled; it still smells of snow.

whiteback_boots.name: Whiteback Boots
whiteback_boots.desc: Studded boots that grip on any floor. Whiteback pelt, shaved and boiled; it still smells of snow.

whiteback_brigandine.name: Whiteback Brigandine
whiteback_brigandine.desc: A fitted brigandine; every plate sits where the last blow landed. Whiteback pelt, shaved and boiled; it still smells of snow.

steeped_steel_helm.name: Steeped Steel Helm
steeped_steel_helm.desc: A plain helm, riveted, with a nasal. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

steeped_steel_plate.name: Steeped Steel Plate
steeped_steel_plate.desc: A plate cuirass with a fauld. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

steeped_steel_gauntlets.name: Steeped Steel Gauntlets
steeped_steel_gauntlets.desc: Plate mitts over a leather glove. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

steeped_steel_sabatons.name: Steeped Steel Sabatons
steeped_steel_sabatons.desc: Steel to the toe and plate to the knee. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

steeped_steel_harness.name: Steeped Steel Harness
steeped_steel_harness.desc: A fitted harness. The price says so twice. Steeped steel sat a season in rich ether and came out changed.

whiteback_frame.name: Whiteback Frame
whiteback_frame.desc: A delving frame with a hip band and lashing points. Whiteback pelt, shaved and boiled; it still smells of snow.

whiteback_belt.name: Whiteback Belt
whiteback_belt.desc: A wide belt: braces, rings and a buckle you can work one-handed. Whiteback pelt, shaved and boiled; it still smells of snow.

steeped_steel_tide_charm.name: Steeped Steel Tide Charm
steeped_steel_tide_charm.desc: A charm set with brinepearl in steeped steel. Water abilities cost less essence.

steeped_steel_tide_talisman.name: Steeped Steel Tide Talisman
steeped_steel_tide_talisman.desc: A talisman of brinepearl bound in steeped steel wire. Water abilities hit a little harder.

steeped_steel_ember_charm.name: Steeped Steel Ember Charm
steeped_steel_ember_charm.desc: A charm set with emberite in steeped steel. Fire abilities cost less essence.

steeped_steel_ember_talisman.name: Steeped Steel Ember Talisman
steeped_steel_ember_talisman.desc: A talisman of emberite bound in steeped steel wire. Fire abilities hit a little harder.

steeped_steel_loam_charm.desc: A charm set with loamstone in steeped steel. Earth abilities cost less essence.

steeped_steel_loam_talisman.name: Steeped Steel Loam Talisman
steeped_steel_loam_talisman.desc: A talisman of loamstone bound in steeped steel wire. Earth abilities hit a little harder.

steeped_steel_gale_charm.name: Steeped Steel Gale Charm
steeped_steel_gale_charm.desc: A charm set with galequill in steeped steel. Wind abilities cost less essence.

steeped_steel_gale_talisman.name: Steeped Steel Gale Talisman
steeped_steel_gale_talisman.desc: A talisman of galequill bound in steeped steel wire. Wind abilities hit a little harder.
