steeped_steel_storm_charm.desc: A charm set with fulgurite in steeped steel. Lightning abilities cost less essence.

steeped_steel_storm_talisman.name: Steeped Steel Storm Talisman
steeped_steel_storm_talisman.desc: A talisman of fulgurite bound in steeped steel wire. Lightning abilities hit a little harder.

steeped_steel_cooling_coil.name: Steeped Steel Cooling Coil
steeped_steel_cooling_coil.desc: A coil of steeped steel that runs cold when you run hot. Reflux bleeds off a little faster.

rime_floss_menders_thread.name: Rime-Floss Mender's Thread
rime_floss_menders_thread.desc: A thread of rime-floss soaked in snowknit, wound round the wrist. Healing spent on a lasting wound goes further.

snowknit_poultice.name: Snowknit Poultice
snowknit_poultice.desc: Snowknit bound in cloth. Out of a fight it returns a fifth of your health over ten seconds and speeds natural healing for five minutes. Ordinary medicine; the star does not mind.

snowknit_salve.name: Snowknit Salve
snowknit_salve.desc: Rubbed into your oldest lasting wound, it does 20 points of the healing that wound is waiting for. Slower than the bonesetter, and you can carry it.

glass_thistle_draught.name: Glass Thistle Draught
glass_thistle_draught.desc: 90 essence, now. It leaves 15 reflux on every affinity, and the delve teaches you a little less.

frostcap_paste.name: Frostcap Paste
frostcap_paste.desc: Cold, grey and smelling of pennies. Takes 36 reflux off your hottest affinity. The delve teaches you a little less for it.

steeped_numbing_salt.name: Steeped Numbing Salt
steeped_numbing_salt.desc: For 70 seconds your wounds cost you nothing. Then each one is a tenth deeper, and the delve teaches you a little less.

steeped_iron_tonic.name: Steeped Iron Tonic
steeped_iron_tonic.desc: An alchemist's strength tonic. Two minutes of strikes 12% harder, then two minutes of strikes a tenth weaker. The delve teaches you a little less.

steeped_pale_tincture.name: Steeped Pale Tincture
steeped_pale_tincture.desc: An ascension aid. It pours blank growth into your newest star. The star fills; what it fills with is nobody in particular. Too many and the talent itself starts to wear.

unbroken_seed.name: Unbroken Seed
unbroken_seed.desc: A true ascension elixir, of no known origin. It fills the newest star and makes what comes next a little more yours. Worth killing for, and people have.

steeped_bleeding_oil.name: Steeped Bleeding Oil
steeped_bleeding_oil.desc: Wiped on an edge: for 22 base strikes each hit opens one more bleeding stack.

steeped_flash_powder.name: Steeped Flash Powder
steeped_flash_powder.desc: Thrown: a white flash. Every wind-up within four metres is broken.

steeped_tether_incense.name: Steeped Tether Incense
steeped_tether_incense.desc: Burned before you sit: your next projection strays 4 metres further from the body.

steeped_binding_salts.name: Steeped Binding Salts
steeped_binding_salts.desc: Scattered in a circle before a binding: the next binding of a construct is a little likelier to hold.

steeped_short_night_pill.name: Steeped Short-Night Pill
steeped_short_night_pill.desc: A night's sleep in an hour. The body is rested; the mind will mention it later.

clouded_brine_charge.name: Clouded Brine Charge
clouded_brine_charge.desc: Your next three water skills shove 40% further. Only for someone with the water affinity. The delve teaches you a little less.

clouded_pitch_wick.name: Clouded Pitch Wick
clouded_pitch_wick.desc: For ten seconds your Heat counts as 25 reflux higher than it is, without the reflux. Only for someone with the fire affinity. The delve teaches you a little less.

clouded_masons_grit.name: Clouded Mason's Grit
clouded_masons_grit.desc: Your next two standing stones have 60% more life and stand half as long again. Only for someone with the earth affinity. The delve teaches you a little less.

clouded_gale_quill.name: Clouded Gale Quill
clouded_gale_quill.desc: 5 Slipstream pips at once. Only for someone with the wind affinity. The delve teaches you a little less.

clouded_charged_filament.name: Clouded Charged Filament
clouded_charged_filament.desc: Your next three lightning hits leave 2 marks instead of one. Only for someone with the lightning affinity. The delve teaches you a little less.

clouded_ether_sliver.name: Clouded Ether Sliver
clouded_ether_sliver.desc: A sliver of settled ether that burns in place of your stars: your next skill's essence cost, up to 36, is paid from it. Its reflux is still yours. The delve teaches you a little less.

steeped_steel_tipped_arrows.name: Steeped Steel-Tipped Arrows
steeped_steel_tipped_arrows.desc: Twenty arrows with steeped steel heads. About half come back.

steeped_steel_bolts.name: Steeped Steel Bolts
steeped_steel_bolts.desc: Twelve short bolts, steeped steel to the shoulder. Most can be dug out.

steeped_steel_shot.name: Steeped Steel Shot
steeped_steel_shot.desc: Thirty cast steeped steel bullets for a sling. Gone once thrown.

spoils_strongbox_b3.name: Steeped Strongbox
spoils_strongbox_b3.desc: Passage spoils, locked and heavy. The counting-house in town opens it and pays.

spoils_relics_b3.name: Steeped Relic Case
spoils_relics_b3.desc: Passage spoils: odd small things the passage gave up. They sell.

spoils_salvage_b3.name: Steeped Salvage
spoils_salvage_b3.desc: Passage spoils: scrap worth having. It sells.

frostbound_tally_stick.name: Frostbound Tally-Stick
frostbound_tally_stick.desc: Soaked through at the middle of a slaughter. Carry it while you project: what waits is more likely to be a remnant.

key_writ_b3.name: Steeped Passage Writ
key_writ_b3.desc: Placeholder: the entry writ for an owned passage rated for 3 stars. Bought at that region's ticket hall.

stalker_hide.name: Tawny Stalker Hide
stalker_hide.desc: From a grass-coloured hunter that is mostly shoulders. Tanners pay by the span. Tanned, it is the band's leather.

step_hound_fang.name: Step-Hound Fang
step_hound_fang.desc: A fang from a hound that follows you from one step to the next. A crafter's masterwork piece for bows, slings and coats.

moth_cocoon.name: Spindle Moth Cocoon
moth_cocoon.desc: A cocoon as long as a forearm. Unwind it slowly or not at all. Spun, it is the band's cloth.

sentinel_clockwork.name: Sentinel Clockwork
sentinel_clockwork.desc: Gears from a tower's sentinel. Some still turn when nobody is looking. A smith's masterwork piece; the metal is the band's own.

collector_seal.name: Collector's Seal
collector_seal.desc: The seal of a thing that collected on debts in a vault. Collectors collect it. Good only for selling, and very good for that.

wardsilver_ore.name: Wardsilver Ore
wardsilver_ore.desc: Ore of wardsilver, from veins and resource caches. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

tawny_ash_log.name: Tawny Ash Log
tawny_ash_log.desc: A length of tawny ash, felled and trimmed. Tawny ash from the grass realm, where trees are rare and argued over.

ether_salt_b4.name: Warded Ether Salt
ether_salt_b4.desc: Plain ether that pooled and crystallised in rich ground. Flux for smiths, base for alchemists, ink for runesetters.

tawny_wort.name: Tawny Wort
tawny_wort.desc: Tawny Wort. Pressed into a wound it pulls the edges toward each other. Apothecaries buy it by the bunch.

step_nettle.name: Step Nettle
step_nettle.desc: Step Nettle. Bitter enough to make an essence draught taste of something worse. The base of most draughts.

spindle_lichen.name: Spindle Lichen
spindle_lichen.desc: Spindle Lichen. Cold to hold in any weather. Alchemists use it to draw heat out of a paste.

grass_realm_fig.name: Grass-Realm Fig
grass_realm_fig.desc: Grass-Realm Fig. Grown in a resource cache that puts it back every reset. Elixir makers pay for it.

wardsilver_bar.name: Wardsilver Bar
wardsilver_bar.desc: A bar of wardsilver. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

wardsilver_wire.name: Wardsilver Wire
wardsilver_wire.desc: Drawn wardsilver wire. It holds grips, rims and rings together.

stalker_hide_leather.name: Stalker-Hide Leather
stalker_hide_leather.desc: Tanned and cut into working sides. Stalker-hide keeps the colour of the grass for a week after it is cut.

tawny_ash_stave.name: Tawny Ash Stave
tawny_ash_stave.desc: Split, seasoned and straight. Tawny ash from the grass realm, where trees are rare and argued over.

moth_silk_bolt.name: Moth-Silk Bolt
moth_silk_bolt.desc: A bolt of woven cloth. Moth-silk from the Spindle, unspooled one careful thread at a time.

rune_ink_b4.name: Warded Rune Ink
rune_ink_b4.desc: Enough ink to write one rune onto one thing of this band. The runesetter does not give refunds.

wardsilver_knuckles.name: Wardsilver Knuckles
wardsilver_knuckles.desc: A pair of knuckle-bars for working hands. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

wardsilver_dusters.name: Wardsilver Dusters
wardsilver_dusters.desc: Dusters with a ridge for each knuckle, fitted close. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

wardsilver_knife.name: Wardsilver Knife
wardsilver_knife.desc: A plain knife, long enough to matter. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

wardsilver_dirk.name: Wardsilver Dirk
wardsilver_dirk.desc: A narrow dirk for finding the gap. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

wardsilver_blade.name: Wardsilver Blade
wardsilver_blade.desc: A one-handed sword, plain and honest. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

wardsilver_sword.name: Wardsilver Sword
wardsilver_sword.desc: A balanced sword made by someone who fought with one. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

wardsilver_axe.name: Wardsilver Axe
wardsilver_axe.desc: A one-handed axe. The cut keeps working after it lands. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

wardsilver_bearded_axe.name: Wardsilver Bearded Axe
wardsilver_bearded_axe.desc: A bearded axe, hooked for shields and ankles. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

wardsilver_mace.name: Wardsilver Mace
wardsilver_mace.desc: A flanged mace. It does not care which flange arrives. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

wardsilver_warhammer.name: Wardsilver Warhammer
wardsilver_warhammer.desc: A warhammer with a beak behind the face. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

wardsilver_spear.name: Wardsilver Spear
wardsilver_spear.desc: A spear: be further away than the other one. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

wardsilver_partisan.name: Wardsilver Partisan
wardsilver_partisan.desc: A partisan with a broad head and side lugs. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

wardsilver_maul.name: Wardsilver Maul
wardsilver_maul.desc: A two-handed maul. One swing, one decision. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

wardsilver_greatsword.name: Wardsilver Greatsword
wardsilver_greatsword.desc: A greatsword long enough to need its own plan. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

wardsilver_throwing_knives.name: Wardsilver Throwing Knives
wardsilver_throwing_knives.desc: A roll of six balanced throwing knives. Most come back. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

wardsilver_javelins.name: Wardsilver Javelins
wardsilver_javelins.desc: Three short javelins. Each goes through the first thing. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

moth_silk_sling.name: Moth-Silk Sling
moth_silk_sling.desc: A sling: a cord, a pouch and whatever is on the ground. Moth-silk from the Spindle, unspooled one careful thread at a time.

stalker_hide_staff_sling.name: Stalker-Hide Staff Sling
stalker_hide_staff_sling.desc: A staff sling for throwing over walls. Stalker-hide keeps the colour of the grass for a week after it is cut.

tawny_ash_bow.name: Tawny Ash Bow
tawny_ash_bow.desc: A hunting bow with a long, easy draw. Tawny ash from the grass realm, where trees are rare and argued over.

tawny_ash_recurve.name: Tawny Ash Recurve
tawny_ash_recurve.desc: A recurve that holds its draw. Tawny ash from the grass realm, where trees are rare and argued over.

tawny_ash_crossbow.name: Tawny Ash Crossbow
tawny_ash_crossbow.desc: A lever crossbow. It does not care how many stars you have. Tawny ash from the grass realm, where trees are rare and argued over.

tawny_ash_arbalest.name: Tawny Ash Arbalest
tawny_ash_arbalest.desc: An arbalest with a crank. One very final noise. Tawny ash from the grass realm, where trees are rare and argued over.

wardsilver_flue.name: Wardsilver Flue
wardsilver_flue.desc: A runed pipe that coughs your own reflux out as shot. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

wardsilver_long_flue.name: Wardsilver Long Flue
wardsilver_long_flue.desc: A long flue with tight seams; less of the heat comes back up your arm. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

wardsilver_buckler.name: Wardsilver Buckler
wardsilver_buckler.desc: A small round buckler, back in place before the next blow. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

tawny_ash_shield.name: Tawny Ash Shield
tawny_ash_shield.desc: A round shield of planks with a boss. Tawny ash from the grass realm, where trees are rare and argued over.

wardsilver_heater_shield.name: Wardsilver Heater Shield
wardsilver_heater_shield.desc: A heater shield, rimmed and faced. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

wardsilver_sump.name: Wardsilver Sump
wardsilver_sump.desc: A stoppered sump: some of what your casting leaves settles in it instead of you. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

wardsilver_tablet.name: Wardsilver Tablet
wardsilver_tablet.desc: A focus tablet with a working written on it. Fewer mistakes, less waste. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

moth_silk_hood.name: Moth-Silk Hood
moth_silk_hood.desc: A hood that sheds rain and a little heat. Moth-silk from the Spindle, unspooled one careful thread at a time.

moth_silk_jack.name: Moth-Silk Jack
moth_silk_jack.desc: A quilted jack. It breathes, which matters more than you think. Moth-silk from the Spindle, unspooled one careful thread at a time.

moth_silk_gloves.name: Moth-Silk Gloves
moth_silk_gloves.desc: Soft gloves; you can feel the grip. Moth-silk from the Spindle, unspooled one careful thread at a time.

moth_silk_runners.name: Moth-Silk Runners
moth_silk_runners.desc: Soft runners with no heel and no noise. Moth-silk from the Spindle, unspooled one careful thread at a time.

moth_silk_long_coat.name: Moth-Silk Long Coat
moth_silk_long_coat.desc: A long coat, waxed, vented and mostly pockets. Moth-silk from the Spindle, unspooled one careful thread at a time.

stalker_hide_cap.name: Stalker-Hide Cap
stalker_hide_cap.desc: A boiled cap, cooked until it gave up being skin. Stalker-hide keeps the colour of the grass for a week after it is cut.

stalker_hide_cuirass.name: Stalker-Hide Cuirass
stalker_hide_cuirass.desc: A cuirass of boiled leather, stiff as a door for the first month. Stalker-hide keeps the colour of the grass for a week after it is cut.

stalker_hide_bracers.name: Stalker-Hide Bracers
stalker_hide_bracers.desc: Bracers between an edge and the arm you need. Stalker-hide keeps the colour of the grass for a week after it is cut.

stalker_hide_boots.name: Stalker-Hide Boots
stalker_hide_boots.desc: Hobnailed boots. You stay where you stood. Stalker-hide keeps the colour of the grass for a week after it is cut.

stalker_hide_brigandine.name: Stalker-Hide Brigandine
stalker_hide_brigandine.desc: A brigandine: plates riveted inside a leather coat. Stalker-hide keeps the colour of the grass for a week after it is cut.

wardsilver_helm.name: Wardsilver Helm
wardsilver_helm.desc: A helm with a brim for things falling off walls. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

wardsilver_plate.name: Wardsilver Plate
wardsilver_plate.desc: Plate front and back. The heat has nowhere to go, and neither do you. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

wardsilver_gauntlets.name: Wardsilver Gauntlets
wardsilver_gauntlets.desc: Gauntlets with no fingers to lose track of. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

wardsilver_sabatons.name: Wardsilver Sabatons
wardsilver_sabatons.desc: Sabatons. Stairs become a negotiation. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

wardsilver_harness.name: Wardsilver Harness
wardsilver_harness.desc: A full harness, measured for you. Wardsilver holds a rune without ink, if it likes you.

stalker_hide_frame.name: Stalker-Hide Frame
stalker_hide_frame.desc: A load-bearing frame for hauling corpses out. Stalker-hide keeps the colour of the grass for a week after it is cut.

stalker_hide_belt.name: Stalker-Hide Belt
stalker_hide_belt.desc: A belt with loops for what you want without looking. Stalker-hide keeps the colour of the grass for a week after it is cut.

wardsilver_tide_charm.name: Wardsilver Tide Charm
wardsilver_tide_charm.desc: A charm set with brinepearl in wardsilver. Water abilities cost less essence.

wardsilver_tide_talisman.name: Wardsilver Tide Talisman
wardsilver_tide_talisman.desc: A talisman of brinepearl bound in wardsilver wire. Water abilities hit a little harder.

wardsilver_ember_charm.name: Wardsilver Ember Charm
wardsilver_ember_charm.desc: A charm set with emberite in wardsilver. Fire abilities cost less essence.

wardsilver_ember_talisman.name: Wardsilver Ember Talisman
wardsilver_ember_talisman.desc: A talisman of emberite bound in wardsilver wire. Fire abilities hit a little harder.

wardsilver_loam_charm.name: Wardsilver Loam Charm
wardsilver_loam_charm.desc: A charm set with loamstone in wardsilver. Earth abilities cost less essence.

wardsilver_loam_talisman.name: Wardsilver Loam Talisman
wardsilver_loam_talisman.desc: A talisman of loamstone bound in wardsilver wire. Earth abilities hit a little harder.

wardsilver_gale_charm.name: Wardsilver Gale Charm
wardsilver_gale_charm.desc: A charm set with galequill in wardsilver. Wind abilities cost less essence.

wardsilver_gale_talisman.name: Wardsilver Gale Talisman
wardsilver_gale_talisman.desc: A talisman of galequill bound in wardsilver wire. Wind abilities hit a little harder.

wardsilver_storm_charm.name: Wardsilver Storm Charm
wardsilver_storm_charm.desc: A charm set with fulgurite in wardsilver. Lightning abilities cost less essence.

wardsilver_storm_talisman.name: Wardsilver Storm Talisman
wardsilver_storm_talisman.desc: A talisman of fulgurite bound in wardsilver wire. Lightning abilities hit a little harder.

wardsilver_cooling_coil.name: Wardsilver Cooling Coil
wardsilver_cooling_coil.desc: A coil of wardsilver that runs cold when you run hot. Reflux bleeds off a little faster.

moth_silk_menders_thread.name: Moth-Silk Mender's Thread
moth_silk_menders_thread.desc: A thread of moth-silk soaked in tawny wort, wound round the wrist. Healing spent on a lasting wound goes further.

tetrad_mote.name: Tetrad Mote
tetrad_mote.desc: A 4-star satellite. It trickles 4 essence a second into you whether you ask or not. Satellites are found or bought; nobody in town can make one.

tawny_wort_poultice.name: Tawny Wort Poultice
tawny_wort_poultice.desc: Tawny Wort bound in cloth. Out of a fight it returns a fifth of your health over ten seconds and speeds natural healing for five minutes. Ordinary medicine; the star does not mind.

tawny_wort_salve.name: Tawny Wort Salve
tawny_wort_salve.desc: Rubbed into your oldest lasting wound, it does 26 points of the healing that wound is waiting for. Slower than the bonesetter, and you can carry it.

warded_regrowth_draught.name: Warded Regrowth Draught
warded_regrowth_draught.desc: Drunk in a safe place, it grows back a lost arm over the night. It itches for a week.

warded_clotting_powder.name: Warded Clotting Powder
warded_clotting_powder.desc: Thrown into a wound mid-fight: bleeding stops, and the next wound you take is a quarter shallower.

step_nettle_draught.name: Step Nettle Draught
step_nettle_draught.desc: 120 essence, now. It leaves 15 reflux on every affinity, and the delve teaches you a little less.

spindle_lichen_paste.name: Spindle Lichen Paste
spindle_lichen_paste.desc: Cold, grey and smelling of pennies. Takes 39 reflux off your hottest affinity. The delve teaches you a little less for it.

warded_steadying_tonic.name: Warded Steadying Tonic
warded_steadying_tonic.desc: Two minutes of steadier feet (more poise), then a minute of wobbling. The delve teaches you a little less.

warded_yard_liniment.name: Warded Yard Liniment
warded_yard_liniment.desc: Rubbed in before a tempering session: the strain it leaves is smaller, and so is what you learn.

warded_pale_tincture.name: Warded Pale Tincture
warded_pale_tincture.desc: An ascension aid. It pours blank growth into your newest star. The star fills; what it fills with is nobody in particular. Too many and the talent itself starts to wear.

warded_sap_venom.name: Warded Sap Venom
warded_sap_venom.desc: For 15 base strikes each hit poisons for 15.3 a second over five seconds. Poison you laid pays your talent like any other harm.

warded_lead_lacquer.name: Warded Lead Lacquer
warded_lead_lacquer.desc: A heavy lacquer for a weapon's head. For 20 base strikes they break poise half again as fast.

warded_smoke_pot.name: Warded Smoke Pot
warded_smoke_pot.desc: Thrown: a bank of smoke three metres across. Nothing shoots through it.

warded_second_skin_wax.name: Warded Second-Skin Wax
warded_second_skin_wax.desc: Rubbed on the temples: your next projection has 4 more life.

warded_trail_ration.name: Warded Trail Ration
warded_trail_ration.desc: Hard bread, dried fruit and something salted. For an hour of the clock natural healing runs a quarter faster.

wardsilver_tipped_arrows.name: Wardsilver-Tipped Arrows
wardsilver_tipped_arrows.desc: Twenty arrows with wardsilver heads. About half come back.

wardsilver_bolts.name: Wardsilver Bolts
wardsilver_bolts.desc: Twelve short bolts, wardsilver to the shoulder. Most can be dug out.

wardsilver_shot.name: Wardsilver Shot
wardsilver_shot.desc: Thirty cast wardsilver bullets for a sling. Gone once thrown.

wardsilver_barbed_arrows.name: Wardsilver Barbed Arrows
wardsilver_barbed_arrows.desc: Twelve barbed arrows. They do not come out the way they went in, so they do not come back.

wardsilver_bodkins.name: Wardsilver Bodkins
wardsilver_bodkins.desc: Twelve square-headed arrows for armour. Front armour and shields count half against them.

wardsilver_blunt_bolts.name: Wardsilver Blunt Bolts
wardsilver_blunt_bolts.desc: Twelve bolts with heavy blunt heads. They break poise, not skin, and nearly all come back.

spoils_strongbox_b4.name: Warded Strongbox
spoils_strongbox_b4.desc: Passage spoils, locked and heavy. The counting-house in town opens it and pays.

spoils_relics_b4.name: Warded Relic Case
spoils_relics_b4.desc: Passage spoils: odd small things the passage gave up. They sell.

spoils_salvage_b4.name: Warded Salvage
spoils_salvage_b4.desc: Passage spoils: scrap worth having. It sells.

spindle_shroud.name: Spindle Shroud
spindle_shroud.desc: Soaked through at the middle of a slaughter. Carry it while you project: what waits is more likely to be a spirit.

key_writ_b4.name: Warded Passage Writ
key_writ_b4.desc: Placeholder: the entry writ for an owned passage rated for 4 stars. Bought at that region's ticket hall.

imprint_the_long_count.name: Spirit Imprint: The Long Count
imprint_the_long_count.desc: Spoken aloud: for 8 seconds every hit on you is written down instead of felt; then all of it arrives at once, halved. A spirit ability: it always has a price, and holding one slows the next star.

vein_drake_hide.name: Vein Drake Hide
vein_drake_hide.desc: A drake that swims through rock. Its scales are mostly rock. Tanned, it is the band's leather.

borer_tooth.name: Borer Tooth
borer_tooth.desc: One tooth out of a worm's ring of hundreds. It still bites into metal. A crafter's masterwork piece for bows, slings and coats.

lantern_weaver_silk.name: Lantern Weaver Silk
lantern_weaver_silk.desc: Silk from a spider that hangs lights to fish with. It glows when warm. Spun, it is the band's cloth.

sexton_bellmetal.name: Sexton Bell-Metal
sexton_bellmetal.desc: A made caretaker's bell, cracked. It rang for every death in its halls. A smith's masterwork piece; the metal is the band's own.

drake_matron_crest.name: Drake Matron's Crest
drake_matron_crest.desc: The crest-plate of a matron drake. Nobody in town will believe you without it. Good only for selling, and very good for that.

veiniron_ore.name: Veiniron Ore
veiniron_ore.desc: Ore of veiniron, from veins and resource caches. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veinwood_log.name: Veinwood Log
veinwood_log.desc: A length of veinwood, felled and trimmed. Veinwood grows on realm rock and drinks what is in it.

ether_salt_b5.name: Veined Ether Salt
ether_salt_b5.desc: Plain ether that pooled and crystallised in rich ground. Flux for smiths, base for alchemists, ink for runesetters.

veinroot.name: Veinroot
veinroot.desc: Veinroot. Pressed into a wound it pulls the edges toward each other. Apothecaries buy it by the bunch.

drakes_pepper.name: Drake's Pepper
drakes_pepper.desc: Drake's Pepper. Bitter enough to make an essence draught taste of something worse. The base of most draughts.

hollow_moss.name: Hollow Moss
hollow_moss.desc: Hollow Moss. Cold to hold in any weather. Alchemists use it to draw heat out of a paste.

rockheart_apple.name: Rockheart Apple
rockheart_apple.desc: Rockheart Apple. Grown in a resource cache that puts it back every reset. Elixir makers pay for it.

veiniron_bar.name: Veiniron Bar
veiniron_bar.desc: A bar of veiniron. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veiniron_wire.name: Veiniron Wire
veiniron_wire.desc: Drawn veiniron wire. It holds grips, rims and rings together.

drakeskin_leather.name: Drakeskin Leather
drakeskin_leather.desc: Tanned and cut into working sides. Drakeskin: scale on the outside, patience on the inside.

veinwood_stave.name: Veinwood Stave
veinwood_stave.desc: Split, seasoned and straight. Veinwood grows on realm rock and drinks what is in it.

lantern_silk_bolt.name: Lantern-Silk Bolt
lantern_silk_bolt.desc: A bolt of woven cloth. Lantern-silk glows faintly when your reflux runs high.

rune_ink_b5.name: Veined Rune Ink
rune_ink_b5.desc: Enough ink to write one rune onto one thing of this band. The runesetter does not give refunds.

clear_brinepearl.name: Clear Brinepearl
clear_brinepearl.desc: Water ether that pooled and set in rich ground, clear all the way through. Charms, talismans and charges are made of it.

clear_emberite.name: Clear Emberite
clear_emberite.desc: Fire ether that pooled and set in rich ground, clear all the way through. Charms, talismans and charges are made of it.

clear_loamstone.name: Clear Loamstone
clear_loamstone.desc: Earth ether that pooled and set in rich ground, clear all the way through. Charms, talismans and charges are made of it.

clear_galequill.name: Clear Galequill
clear_galequill.desc: Wind ether that pooled and set in rich ground, clear all the way through. Charms, talismans and charges are made of it.

clear_fulgurite.name: Clear Fulgurite
clear_fulgurite.desc: Lightning ether that pooled and set in rich ground, clear all the way through. Charms, talismans and charges are made of it.

veiniron_knuckles.name: Veiniron Knuckles
veiniron_knuckles.desc: Your fists, with an argument added. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veiniron_dusters.name: Veiniron Dusters
veiniron_dusters.desc: Close-fitted dusters, every edge filed to your grip. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veiniron_knife.name: Veiniron Knife
veiniron_knife.desc: A working knife. Most of what it meets is softer than it. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veiniron_dirk.name: Veiniron Dirk
veiniron_dirk.desc: A dirk ground thin enough to slip between plates. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veiniron_blade.name: Veiniron Blade
veiniron_blade.desc: An issue sword: stamped, numbered, dependable. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veiniron_sword.name: Veiniron Sword
veiniron_sword.desc: A long one-handed sword with a quiet edge. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veiniron_axe.name: Veiniron Axe
veiniron_axe.desc: A hatchet grown up. It opens what it hits. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veiniron_bearded_axe.name: Veiniron Bearded Axe
veiniron_bearded_axe.desc: A broad bearded head on a short haft. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veiniron_mace.name: Veiniron Mace
veiniron_mace.desc: A mace for things wearing more than you are. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veiniron_warhammer.name: Veiniron Warhammer
veiniron_warhammer.desc: A short warhammer, weighted forward. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veiniron_spear.name: Veiniron Spear
veiniron_spear.desc: A plain spear on a long haft. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veiniron_partisan.name: Veiniron Partisan
veiniron_partisan.desc: A partisan built to hold a doorway. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veiniron_maul.name: Veiniron Maul
veiniron_maul.desc: A great maul: both hands, all of your attention. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veiniron_greatsword.name: Veiniron Greatsword
veiniron_greatsword.desc: A two-handed blade with a ricasso to choke up on. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veiniron_throwing_knives.name: Veiniron Throwing Knives
veiniron_throwing_knives.desc: Throwing knives in a bandolier, weighted at the tip. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veiniron_javelins.name: Veiniron Javelins
veiniron_javelins.desc: A quiver of javelins with long iron shanks. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

lantern_silk_sling.name: Lantern-Silk Sling
lantern_silk_sling.desc: A braided sling that never runs out of stones. Lantern-silk glows faintly when your reflux runs high.

drakeskin_staff_sling.name: Drakeskin Staff Sling
drakeskin_staff_sling.desc: A sling on a pole; it throws a stone the size of a fist. Drakeskin: scale on the outside, patience on the inside.

veinwood_bow.name: Veinwood Bow
veinwood_bow.desc: A plain self bow. Stand still and it pays. Veinwood grows on realm rock and drinks what is in it.

veinwood_recurve.name: Veinwood Recurve
veinwood_recurve.desc: A war recurve, short enough to turn with. Veinwood grows on realm rock and drinks what is in it.

veinwood_crossbow.name: Veinwood Crossbow
veinwood_crossbow.desc: A crossbow spanned by a lever, one bolt at a time. Veinwood grows on realm rock and drinks what is in it.

veinwood_arbalest.name: Veinwood Arbalest
veinwood_arbalest.desc: A heavy arbalest; the windlass hangs at the hip. Veinwood grows on realm rock and drinks what is in it.

veiniron_flue.name: Veiniron Flue
veiniron_flue.desc: A plain flue: you cast, it vents, something falls over. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veiniron_long_flue.name: Veiniron Long Flue
veiniron_long_flue.desc: A long-barrelled flue, runed along every seam. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veiniron_buckler.name: Veiniron Buckler
veiniron_buckler.desc: A fist-sized boss with a rim. Quick, not deep. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veinwood_shield.name: Veinwood Shield
veinwood_shield.desc: A plain shield. It takes what it is given. Veinwood grows on realm rock and drinks what is in it.

veiniron_heater_shield.name: Veiniron Heater Shield
veiniron_heater_shield.desc: A banded heater shield with a fitted grip. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veiniron_sump.name: Veiniron Sump
veiniron_sump.desc: A squat sump-jar. It hums when it is full. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veiniron_tablet.name: Veiniron Tablet
veiniron_tablet.desc: A runed tablet: someone else's working, and theirs was better. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

lantern_silk_hood.name: Lantern-Silk Hood
lantern_silk_hood.desc: A close hood; it breathes. Lantern-silk glows faintly when your reflux runs high.

lantern_silk_jack.name: Lantern-Silk Jack
lantern_silk_jack.desc: A padded jack, quilted in diamonds. Lantern-silk glows faintly when your reflux runs high.

lantern_silk_gloves.name: Lantern-Silk Gloves
lantern_silk_gloves.desc: Thin gloves, close at the wrist. Lantern-silk glows faintly when your reflux runs high.

lantern_silk_runners.name: Lantern-Silk Runners
lantern_silk_runners.desc: Light shoes for people who are paid to arrive. Lantern-silk glows faintly when your reflux runs high.

lantern_silk_long_coat.name: Lantern-Silk Long Coat
lantern_silk_long_coat.desc: A delving coat cut long, with a hood rolled at the collar. Lantern-silk glows faintly when your reflux runs high.

drakeskin_cap.name: Drakeskin Cap
drakeskin_cap.desc: A stiff cap with a brow-band. Drakeskin: scale on the outside, patience on the inside.

drakeskin_cuirass.name: Drakeskin Cuirass
drakeskin_cuirass.desc: A moulded leather cuirass laced at the side. Drakeskin: scale on the outside, patience on the inside.

drakeskin_bracers.name: Drakeskin Bracers
drakeskin_bracers.desc: Laced bracers with a rib down the forearm. Drakeskin: scale on the outside, patience on the inside.

drakeskin_boots.name: Drakeskin Boots
drakeskin_boots.desc: Studded boots that grip on any floor. Drakeskin: scale on the outside, patience on the inside.

drakeskin_brigandine.name: Drakeskin Brigandine
drakeskin_brigandine.desc: A fitted brigandine; every plate sits where the last blow landed. Drakeskin: scale on the outside, patience on the inside.

veiniron_helm.name: Veiniron Helm
veiniron_helm.desc: A plain helm, riveted, with a nasal. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veiniron_plate.name: Veiniron Plate
veiniron_plate.desc: A plate cuirass with a fauld. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veiniron_gauntlets.name: Veiniron Gauntlets
veiniron_gauntlets.desc: Plate mitts over a leather glove. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veiniron_sabatons.name: Veiniron Sabatons
veiniron_sabatons.desc: Steel to the toe and plate to the knee. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

veiniron_harness.name: Veiniron Harness
veiniron_harness.desc: A fitted harness. The price says so twice. Veiniron is dug, not smelted: it grows through realm rock like a root.

drakeskin_frame.name: Drakeskin Frame
drakeskin_frame.desc: A delving frame with a hip band and lashing points. Drakeskin: scale on the outside, patience on the inside.

drakeskin_belt.name: Drakeskin Belt
drakeskin_belt.desc: A wide belt: braces, rings and a buckle you can work one-handed. Drakeskin: scale on the outside, patience on the inside.

veiniron_tide_charm.name: Veiniron Tide Charm
veiniron_tide_charm.desc: A charm set with brinepearl in veiniron. Water abilities cost less essence.

veiniron_tide_talisman.name: Veiniron Tide Talisman
veiniron_tide_talisman.desc: A talisman of brinepearl bound in veiniron wire. Water abilities hit a little harder.

veiniron_ember_charm.name: Veiniron Ember Charm
veiniron_ember_charm.desc: A charm set with emberite in veiniron. Fire abilities cost less essence.

veiniron_ember_talisman.name: Veiniron Ember Talisman
veiniron_ember_talisman.desc: A talisman of emberite bound in veiniron wire. Fire abilities hit a little harder.

veiniron_loam_charm.name: Veiniron Loam Charm
veiniron_loam_charm.desc: A charm set with loamstone in veiniron. Earth abilities cost less essence.

veiniron_loam_talisman.name: Veiniron Loam Talisman
veiniron_loam_talisman.desc: A talisman of loamstone bound in veiniron wire. Earth abilities hit a little harder.

veiniron_gale_charm.name: Veiniron Gale Charm
veiniron_gale_charm.desc: A charm set with galequill in veiniron. Wind abilities cost less essence.

veiniron_gale_talisman.name: Veiniron Gale Talisman
veiniron_gale_talisman.desc: A talisman of galequill bound in veiniron wire. Wind abilities hit a little harder.

veiniron_storm_charm.name: Veiniron Storm Charm
veiniron_storm_charm.desc: A charm set with fulgurite in veiniron. Lightning abilities cost less essence.

veiniron_storm_talisman.name: Veiniron Storm Talisman
veiniron_storm_talisman.desc: A talisman of fulgurite bound in veiniron wire. Lightning abilities hit a little harder.

veiniron_cooling_coil.name: Veiniron Cooling Coil
veiniron_cooling_coil.desc: A coil of veiniron that runs cold when you run hot. Reflux bleeds off a little faster.

lantern_silk_menders_thread.name: Lantern-Silk Mender's Thread
lantern_silk_menders_thread.desc: A thread of lantern-silk soaked in veinroot, wound round the wrist. Healing spent on a lasting wound goes further.

pentad_mote.name: Pentad Mote
pentad_mote.desc: A 5-star satellite. It trickles 5 essence a second into you whether you ask or not. Satellites are found or bought; nobody in town can make one.

veinroot_poultice.name: Veinroot Poultice
veinroot_poultice.desc: Veinroot bound in cloth. Out of a fight it returns a fifth of your health over ten seconds and speeds natural healing for five minutes. Ordinary medicine; the star does not mind.

veinroot_salve.name: Veinroot Salve
veinroot_salve.desc: Rubbed into your oldest lasting wound, it does 34 points of the healing that wound is waiting for. Slower than the bonesetter, and you can carry it.

drakes_pepper_draught.name: Drake's Pepper Draught
drakes_pepper_draught.desc: 150 essence, now. It leaves 15 reflux on every affinity, and the delve teaches you a little less.

hollow_moss_paste.name: Hollow Moss Paste
hollow_moss_paste.desc: Cold, grey and smelling of pennies. Takes 42 reflux off your hottest affinity. The delve teaches you a little less for it.

veined_numbing_salt.name: Veined Numbing Salt
veined_numbing_salt.desc: For 80 seconds your wounds cost you nothing. Then each one is a tenth deeper, and the delve teaches you a little less.

veined_iron_tonic.name: Veined Iron Tonic
veined_iron_tonic.desc: An alchemist's strength tonic. Two minutes of strikes 14% harder, then two minutes of strikes a tenth weaker. The delve teaches you a little less.

veined_pale_tincture.name: Veined Pale Tincture
veined_pale_tincture.desc: An ascension aid. It pours blank growth into your newest star. The star fills; what it fills with is nobody in particular. Too many and the talent itself starts to wear.

veined_blank_draught.name: Veined Blank Draught
veined_blank_draught.desc: A soul elixir from a clinic. It patches soul damage with blank tissue. For small cracks, nobody notices; for big ones, slowly, you become someone else.

root_cut_elixir.name: Root-Cut Elixir
root_cut_elixir.desc: It severs the path you climbed by. Every star goes, and you may climb again by any way you like. Severed powerhouses are a known type; most do not come back up.

veined_bleeding_oil.name: Veined Bleeding Oil
veined_bleeding_oil.desc: Wiped on an edge: for 24 base strikes each hit opens one more bleeding stack.

veined_caltrops.name: Veined Caltrops
veined_caltrops.desc: Thrown: a spray of spikes. Anything walking through them goes four-tenths slower.

veined_tether_incense.name: Veined Tether Incense
veined_tether_incense.desc: Burned before you sit: your next projection strays 5 metres further from the body.

veined_binding_salts.name: Veined Binding Salts
veined_binding_salts.desc: Scattered in a circle before a binding: the next binding of a construct is a little likelier to hold.

clear_brine_charge.name: Clear Brine Charge
clear_brine_charge.desc: Your next three water skills shove 50% further. Only for someone with the water affinity. The delve teaches you a little less.

clear_pitch_wick.name: Clear Pitch Wick
clear_pitch_wick.desc: For ten seconds your Heat counts as 30 reflux higher than it is, without the reflux. Only for someone with the fire affinity. The delve teaches you a little less.

clear_masons_grit.name: Clear Mason's Grit
clear_masons_grit.desc: Your next two standing stones have 70% more life and stand half as long again. Only for someone with the earth affinity. The delve teaches you a little less.

clear_gale_quill.name: Clear Gale Quill
clear_gale_quill.desc: 6 Slipstream pips at once. Only for someone with the wind affinity. The delve teaches you a little less.

clear_charged_filament.name: Clear Charged Filament
clear_charged_filament.desc: Your next three lightning hits leave 2 marks instead of one. Only for someone with the lightning affinity. The delve teaches you a little less.

clear_ether_sliver.name: Clear Ether Sliver
clear_ether_sliver.desc: A sliver of settled ether that burns in place of your stars: your next skill's essence cost, up to 60, is paid from it. Its reflux is still yours. The delve teaches you a little less.

veiniron_tipped_arrows.name: Veiniron-Tipped Arrows
veiniron_tipped_arrows.desc: Twenty arrows with veiniron heads. About half come back.

veiniron_bolts.name: Veiniron Bolts
veiniron_bolts.desc: Twelve short bolts, veiniron to the shoulder. Most can be dug out.

veiniron_shot.name: Veiniron Shot
veiniron_shot.desc: Thirty cast veiniron bullets for a sling. Gone once thrown.

spoils_strongbox_b5.name: Veined Strongbox
spoils_strongbox_b5.desc: Passage spoils, locked and heavy. The counting-house in town opens it and pays.

spoils_relics_b5.name: Veined Relic Case
spoils_relics_b5.desc: Passage spoils: odd small things the passage gave up. They sell.

spoils_salvage_b5.name: Veined Salvage
spoils_salvage_b5.desc: Passage spoils: scrap worth having. It sells.

drake_gnawed_shield.name: Drake-Gnawed Shield
drake_gnawed_shield.desc: Soaked through at the middle of a slaughter. Carry it while you project: what waits is more likely to be a eidolon.

key_writ_b5.name: Veined Passage Writ
key_writ_b5.desc: Placeholder: the entry writ for an owned passage rated for 5 stars. Bought at that region's ticket hall.

lesser_concord_stone.name: Lesser Concord Stone
lesser_concord_stone.desc: Placeholder (sets are parked): fuses 3 items into a set that shares a bonus. Needs a master artificer, and does not always take.

gloam_stag_hide.name: Gloam Stag Hide
gloam_stag_hide.desc: A stag that grazes where there has never been a sun. The hide is cool to touch. Tanned, it is the band's leather.

duskwing_bone.name: Duskwing Bone
duskwing_bone.desc: A hollow wing-bone. It whistles in no wind at all. A crafter's masterwork piece for bows, slings and coats.

pale_fleece.name: Pale Shearling Fleece
pale_fleece.desc: Sheared off a dark-grazing beast that does not mind. Sold by the bale. Spun, it is the band's cloth.

mirror_plate.name: Mirror Knight Plate
mirror_plate.desc: A plate off a made knight that fought with your own face. It reflects badly. A smith's masterwork piece; the metal is the band's own.

lamplighter_lantern.name: Lamplighter's Lantern
lamplighter_lantern.desc: The only light in a dark realm, taken off what carried it. It is out now. Good only for selling, and very good for that.

duskmetal_ore.name: Duskmetal Ore
duskmetal_ore.desc: Ore of duskmetal, from veins and resource caches. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

gloamwood_log.name: Gloamwood Log
gloamwood_log.desc: A length of gloamwood, felled and trimmed. Gloamwood bends like a thought and comes back.

ether_salt_b6.name: Dusk Ether Salt
ether_salt_b6.desc: Plain ether that pooled and crystallised in rich ground. Flux for smiths, base for alchemists, ink for runesetters.

gloam_lily.name: Gloam Lily
gloam_lily.desc: Gloam Lily. Pressed into a wound it pulls the edges toward each other. Apothecaries buy it by the bunch.

dusk_fennel.name: Dusk Fennel
dusk_fennel.desc: Dusk Fennel. Bitter enough to make an essence draught taste of something worse. The base of most draughts.

pale_cap.name: Pale Cap
pale_cap.desc: Pale Cap. Cold to hold in any weather. Alchemists use it to draw heat out of a paste.

moonless_pear.name: Moonless Pear
moonless_pear.desc: Moonless Pear. Grown in a resource cache that puts it back every reset. Elixir makers pay for it.

duskmetal_bar.name: Duskmetal Bar
duskmetal_bar.desc: A bar of duskmetal. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

duskmetal_wire.name: Duskmetal Wire
duskmetal_wire.desc: Drawn duskmetal wire. It holds grips, rims and rings together.

gloamhide_leather.name: Gloamhide Leather
gloamhide_leather.desc: Tanned and cut into working sides. Gloamhide stays cool in any weather.

gloamwood_stave.name: Gloamwood Stave
gloamwood_stave.desc: Split, seasoned and straight. Gloamwood bends like a thought and comes back.

pale_fleece_bolt.name: Pale Fleece Bolt
pale_fleece_bolt.desc: A bolt of woven cloth. Pale fleece, from beasts that graze in the dark.

rune_ink_b6.name: Dusk Rune Ink
rune_ink_b6.desc: Enough ink to write one rune onto one thing of this band. The runesetter does not give refunds.

duskmetal_knuckles.name: Duskmetal Knuckles
duskmetal_knuckles.desc: A pair of knuckle-bars for working hands. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

duskmetal_dusters.name: Duskmetal Dusters
duskmetal_dusters.desc: Dusters with a ridge for each knuckle, fitted close. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

duskmetal_knife.name: Duskmetal Knife
duskmetal_knife.desc: A plain knife, long enough to matter. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

duskmetal_dirk.name: Duskmetal Dirk
duskmetal_dirk.desc: A narrow dirk for finding the gap. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

duskmetal_blade.name: Duskmetal Blade
duskmetal_blade.desc: A one-handed sword, plain and honest. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

duskmetal_sword.name: Duskmetal Sword
duskmetal_sword.desc: A balanced sword made by someone who fought with one. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

duskmetal_axe.name: Duskmetal Axe
duskmetal_axe.desc: A one-handed axe. The cut keeps working after it lands. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

duskmetal_bearded_axe.name: Duskmetal Bearded Axe
duskmetal_bearded_axe.desc: A bearded axe, hooked for shields and ankles. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

duskmetal_mace.name: Duskmetal Mace
duskmetal_mace.desc: A flanged mace. It does not care which flange arrives. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

duskmetal_warhammer.name: Duskmetal Warhammer
duskmetal_warhammer.desc: A warhammer with a beak behind the face. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

duskmetal_spear.name: Duskmetal Spear
duskmetal_spear.desc: A spear: be further away than the other one. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

duskmetal_partisan.name: Duskmetal Partisan
duskmetal_partisan.desc: A partisan with a broad head and side lugs. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

duskmetal_maul.name: Duskmetal Maul
duskmetal_maul.desc: A two-handed maul. One swing, one decision. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

duskmetal_greatsword.name: Duskmetal Greatsword
duskmetal_greatsword.desc: A greatsword long enough to need its own plan. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

duskmetal_throwing_knives.name: Duskmetal Throwing Knives
duskmetal_throwing_knives.desc: A roll of six balanced throwing knives. Most come back. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

duskmetal_javelins.name: Duskmetal Javelins
duskmetal_javelins.desc: Three short javelins. Each goes through the first thing. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

pale_fleece_sling.name: Pale Fleece Sling
pale_fleece_sling.desc: A sling: a cord, a pouch and whatever is on the ground. Pale fleece, from beasts that graze in the dark.

gloamhide_staff_sling.name: Gloamhide Staff Sling
gloamhide_staff_sling.desc: A staff sling for throwing over walls. Gloamhide stays cool in any weather.

gloamwood_bow.name: Gloamwood Bow
gloamwood_bow.desc: A hunting bow with a long, easy draw. Gloamwood bends like a thought and comes back.

gloamwood_recurve.name: Gloamwood Recurve
gloamwood_recurve.desc: A recurve that holds its draw. Gloamwood bends like a thought and comes back.

gloamwood_crossbow.name: Gloamwood Crossbow
gloamwood_crossbow.desc: A lever crossbow. It does not care how many stars you have. Gloamwood bends like a thought and comes back.

gloamwood_arbalest.name: Gloamwood Arbalest
gloamwood_arbalest.desc: An arbalest with a crank. One very final noise. Gloamwood bends like a thought and comes back.

duskmetal_flue.name: Duskmetal Flue
duskmetal_flue.desc: A runed pipe that coughs your own reflux out as shot. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

duskmetal_long_flue.name: Duskmetal Long Flue
duskmetal_long_flue.desc: A long flue with tight seams; less of the heat comes back up your arm. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

duskmetal_buckler.name: Duskmetal Buckler
duskmetal_buckler.desc: A small round buckler, back in place before the next blow. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

gloamwood_shield.name: Gloamwood Shield
gloamwood_shield.desc: A round shield of planks with a boss. Gloamwood bends like a thought and comes back.

duskmetal_heater_shield.name: Duskmetal Heater Shield
duskmetal_heater_shield.desc: A heater shield, rimmed and faced. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

duskmetal_sump.name: Duskmetal Sump
duskmetal_sump.desc: A stoppered sump: some of what your casting leaves settles in it instead of you. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

duskmetal_tablet.name: Duskmetal Tablet
duskmetal_tablet.desc: A focus tablet with a working written on it. Fewer mistakes, less waste. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

pale_fleece_hood.name: Pale Fleece Hood
pale_fleece_hood.desc: A hood that sheds rain and a little heat. Pale fleece, from beasts that graze in the dark.

pale_fleece_jack.name: Pale Fleece Jack
pale_fleece_jack.desc: A quilted jack. It breathes, which matters more than you think. Pale fleece, from beasts that graze in the dark.

pale_fleece_gloves.name: Pale Fleece Gloves
pale_fleece_gloves.desc: Soft gloves; you can feel the grip. Pale fleece, from beasts that graze in the dark.

pale_fleece_runners.name: Pale Fleece Runners
pale_fleece_runners.desc: Soft runners with no heel and no noise. Pale fleece, from beasts that graze in the dark.

pale_fleece_long_coat.name: Pale Fleece Long Coat
pale_fleece_long_coat.desc: A long coat, waxed, vented and mostly pockets. Pale fleece, from beasts that graze in the dark.

gloamhide_cap.name: Gloamhide Cap
gloamhide_cap.desc: A boiled cap, cooked until it gave up being skin. Gloamhide stays cool in any weather.

gloamhide_cuirass.name: Gloamhide Cuirass
gloamhide_cuirass.desc: A cuirass of boiled leather, stiff as a door for the first month. Gloamhide stays cool in any weather.

gloamhide_bracers.name: Gloamhide Bracers
gloamhide_bracers.desc: Bracers between an edge and the arm you need. Gloamhide stays cool in any weather.

gloamhide_boots.name: Gloamhide Boots
gloamhide_boots.desc: Hobnailed boots. You stay where you stood. Gloamhide stays cool in any weather.

gloamhide_brigandine.name: Gloamhide Brigandine
gloamhide_brigandine.desc: A brigandine: plates riveted inside a leather coat. Gloamhide stays cool in any weather.

duskmetal_helm.name: Duskmetal Helm
duskmetal_helm.desc: A helm with a brim for things falling off walls. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

duskmetal_plate.name: Duskmetal Plate
duskmetal_plate.desc: Plate front and back. The heat has nowhere to go, and neither do you. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

duskmetal_gauntlets.name: Duskmetal Gauntlets
duskmetal_gauntlets.desc: Gauntlets with no fingers to lose track of. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

duskmetal_sabatons.name: Duskmetal Sabatons
duskmetal_sabatons.desc: Sabatons. Stairs become a negotiation. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

duskmetal_harness.name: Duskmetal Harness
duskmetal_harness.desc: A full harness, measured for you. Duskmetal drinks the light along its edges.

gloamhide_frame.name: Gloamhide Frame
gloamhide_frame.desc: A load-bearing frame for hauling corpses out. Gloamhide stays cool in any weather.

gloamhide_belt.name: Gloamhide Belt
gloamhide_belt.desc: A belt with loops for what you want without looking. Gloamhide stays cool in any weather.

duskmetal_tide_charm.name: Duskmetal Tide Charm
duskmetal_tide_charm.desc: A charm set with brinepearl in duskmetal. Water abilities cost less essence.

duskmetal_tide_talisman.name: Duskmetal Tide Talisman
duskmetal_tide_talisman.desc: A talisman of brinepearl bound in duskmetal wire. Water abilities hit a little harder.

duskmetal_ember_charm.name: Duskmetal Ember Charm
duskmetal_ember_charm.desc: A charm set with emberite in duskmetal. Fire abilities cost less essence.

duskmetal_ember_talisman.name: Duskmetal Ember Talisman
duskmetal_ember_talisman.desc: A talisman of emberite bound in duskmetal wire. Fire abilities hit a little harder.

duskmetal_loam_charm.name: Duskmetal Loam Charm
duskmetal_loam_charm.desc: A charm set with loamstone in duskmetal. Earth abilities cost less essence.

duskmetal_loam_talisman.name: Duskmetal Loam Talisman
duskmetal_loam_talisman.desc: A talisman of loamstone bound in duskmetal wire. Earth abilities hit a little harder.

duskmetal_gale_charm.name: Duskmetal Gale Charm
duskmetal_gale_charm.desc: A charm set with galequill in duskmetal. Wind abilities cost less essence.

duskmetal_gale_talisman.name: Duskmetal Gale Talisman
duskmetal_gale_talisman.desc: A talisman of galequill bound in duskmetal wire. Wind abilities hit a little harder.

duskmetal_storm_charm.name: Duskmetal Storm Charm
duskmetal_storm_charm.desc: A charm set with fulgurite in duskmetal. Lightning abilities cost less essence.

duskmetal_storm_talisman.name: Duskmetal Storm Talisman
duskmetal_storm_talisman.desc: A talisman of fulgurite bound in duskmetal wire. Lightning abilities hit a little harder.

duskmetal_cooling_coil.name: Duskmetal Cooling Coil
duskmetal_cooling_coil.desc: A coil of duskmetal that runs cold when you run hot. Reflux bleeds off a little faster.

pale_fleece_menders_thread.name: Pale Fleece Mender's Thread
pale_fleece_menders_thread.desc: A thread of pale fleece soaked in gloam lily, wound round the wrist. Healing spent on a lasting wound goes further.

hexad_mote.name: Hexad Mote
hexad_mote.desc: A 6-star satellite. It trickles 6 essence a second into you whether you ask or not. Satellites are found or bought; nobody in town can make one.

gloam_lily_poultice.name: Gloam Lily Poultice
gloam_lily_poultice.desc: Gloam Lily bound in cloth. Out of a fight it returns a fifth of your health over ten seconds and speeds natural healing for five minutes. Ordinary medicine; the star does not mind.

gloam_lily_salve.name: Gloam Lily Salve
gloam_lily_salve.desc: Rubbed into your oldest lasting wound, it does 45 points of the healing that wound is waiting for. Slower than the bonesetter, and you can carry it.

dusk_clotting_powder.name: Dusk Clotting Powder
dusk_clotting_powder.desc: Thrown into a wound mid-fight: bleeding stops, and the next wound you take is a quarter shallower.

dusk_fennel_draught.name: Dusk Fennel Draught
dusk_fennel_draught.desc: 180 essence, now. It leaves 15 reflux on every affinity, and the delve teaches you a little less.

pale_cap_paste.name: Pale Cap Paste
pale_cap_paste.desc: Cold, grey and smelling of pennies. Takes 45 reflux off every affinity. The delve teaches you a little less for it.

dusk_steadying_tonic.name: Dusk Steadying Tonic
dusk_steadying_tonic.desc: Two minutes of steadier feet (more poise), then a minute of wobbling. The delve teaches you a little less.

dusk_yard_liniment.name: Dusk Yard Liniment
dusk_yard_liniment.desc: Rubbed in before a tempering session: the strain it leaves is smaller, and so is what you learn.

dusk_pale_tincture.name: Dusk Pale Tincture
dusk_pale_tincture.desc: An ascension aid. It pours blank growth into your newest star. The star fills; what it fills with is nobody in particular. Too many and the talent itself starts to wear.

unbroken_root.name: Unbroken Root
unbroken_root.desc: A true ascension elixir, of no known origin. It fills the newest star and makes what comes next a little more yours. Worth killing for, and people have.

dusk_sap_venom.name: Dusk Sap Venom
dusk_sap_venom.desc: For 15 base strikes each hit poisons for 28.4 a second over five seconds. Poison you laid pays your talent like any other harm.

dusk_flash_powder.name: Dusk Flash Powder
dusk_flash_powder.desc: Thrown: a white flash. Every wind-up within four metres is broken.

dusk_second_skin_wax.name: Dusk Second-Skin Wax
dusk_second_skin_wax.desc: Rubbed on the temples: your next projection has 5 more life.

dusk_short_night_pill.name: Dusk Short-Night Pill
dusk_short_night_pill.desc: A night's sleep in an hour. The body is rested; the mind will mention it later.

duskmetal_tipped_arrows.name: Duskmetal-Tipped Arrows
duskmetal_tipped_arrows.desc: Twenty arrows with duskmetal heads. About half come back.

duskmetal_bolts.name: Duskmetal Bolts
duskmetal_bolts.desc: Twelve short bolts, duskmetal to the shoulder. Most can be dug out.

duskmetal_shot.name: Duskmetal Shot
duskmetal_shot.desc: Thirty cast duskmetal bullets for a sling. Gone once thrown.

spoils_strongbox_b6.name: Dusk Strongbox
spoils_strongbox_b6.desc: Passage spoils, locked and heavy. The counting-house in town opens it and pays.

spoils_relics_b6.name: Dusk Relic Case
spoils_relics_b6.desc: Passage spoils: odd small things the passage gave up. They sell.

spoils_salvage_b6.name: Dusk Salvage
spoils_salvage_b6.desc: Passage spoils: scrap worth having. It sells.

lampless_lantern.name: Lampless Lantern
lampless_lantern.desc: Soaked through at the middle of a slaughter. Carry it while you project: what waits is more likely to be a eidolon.

key_writ_b6.name: Dusk Passage Writ
key_writ_b6.desc: Placeholder: the entry writ for an owned passage rated for 6 stars. Bought at that region's ticket hall.

imprint_bargain_struck.name: Spirit Imprint: Bargain Struck
imprint_bargain_struck.desc: Spoken aloud: a fifth of your health is gone until the fight ends, and every hit you deal is 30% harder until then. A spirit ability: it always has a price, and holding one slows the next star.

mantle_wyrm_hide.name: Mantle Wyrm Hide
mantle_wyrm_hide.desc: From under a mountain. It takes two people to roll and one fool to carry. Tanned, it is the band's leather.

hush_cat_claw.name: Hush Cat Claw
hush_cat_claw.desc: A claw from a cat that makes no sound. Neither does the claw, dropped. A crafter's masterwork piece for bows, slings and coats.

still_spider_silk.name: Still Spider Silk
still_spider_silk.desc: Silk that does not sway. Bowyers would kill for it, and some have. Spun, it is the band's cloth.

colossus_joint.name: Quiet Colossus Joint
colossus_joint.desc: A knee from a giant made thing that never made a sound. Heavy. A smith's masterwork piece; the metal is the band's own.

choir_bell.name: Choir Mother's Bell
choir_bell.desc: The bell from the thing that sang the others to sleep. Do not ring it. Good only for selling, and very good for that.

stillsteel_ore.name: Stillsteel Ore
stillsteel_ore.desc: Ore of stillsteel, from veins and resource caches. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillwood_log.name: Stillwood Log
stillwood_log.desc: A length of stillwood, felled and trimmed. Stillwood does not warp, crack or forgive.

ether_salt_b7.name: Still Ether Salt
ether_salt_b7.desc: Plain ether that pooled and crystallised in rich ground. Flux for smiths, base for alchemists, ink for runesetters.

hushleaf.name: Hushleaf
hushleaf.desc: Hushleaf. Pressed into a wound it pulls the edges toward each other. Apothecaries buy it by the bunch.

still_fern.name: Still Fern
still_fern.desc: Still Fern. Bitter enough to make an essence draught taste of something worse. The base of most draughts.

choir_reed.name: Choir Reed
choir_reed.desc: Choir Reed. Cold to hold in any weather. Alchemists use it to draw heat out of a paste.

silent_date.name: Silent Date
silent_date.desc: Silent Date. Grown in a resource cache that puts it back every reset. Elixir makers pay for it.

stillsteel_bar.name: Stillsteel Bar
stillsteel_bar.desc: A bar of stillsteel. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillsteel_wire.name: Stillsteel Wire
stillsteel_wire.desc: Drawn stillsteel wire. It holds grips, rims and rings together.

wyrmhide_leather.name: Wyrmhide Leather
wyrmhide_leather.desc: Tanned and cut into working sides. Wyrmhide was cut from something that lived under a mountain.

stillwood_stave.name: Stillwood Stave
stillwood_stave.desc: Split, seasoned and straight. Stillwood does not warp, crack or forgive.

still_silk_bolt.name: Still-Silk Bolt
still_silk_bolt.desc: A bolt of woven cloth. Still-silk makes no sound, moving or not.

rune_ink_b7.name: Still Rune Ink
rune_ink_b7.desc: Enough ink to write one rune onto one thing of this band. The runesetter does not give refunds.

bright_brinepearl.name: Bright Brinepearl
bright_brinepearl.desc: Water ether that pooled and set in rich ground, bright all the way through. Charms, talismans and charges are made of it.

bright_emberite.name: Bright Emberite
bright_emberite.desc: Fire ether that pooled and set in rich ground, bright all the way through. Charms, talismans and charges are made of it.

bright_loamstone.name: Bright Loamstone
bright_loamstone.desc: Earth ether that pooled and set in rich ground, bright all the way through. Charms, talismans and charges are made of it.

bright_galequill.name: Bright Galequill
bright_galequill.desc: Wind ether that pooled and set in rich ground, bright all the way through. Charms, talismans and charges are made of it.

bright_fulgurite.name: Bright Fulgurite
bright_fulgurite.desc: Lightning ether that pooled and set in rich ground, bright all the way through. Charms, talismans and charges are made of it.

stillsteel_knuckles.name: Stillsteel Knuckles
stillsteel_knuckles.desc: Your fists, with an argument added. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillsteel_dusters.name: Stillsteel Dusters
stillsteel_dusters.desc: Close-fitted dusters, every edge filed to your grip. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillsteel_knife.name: Stillsteel Knife
stillsteel_knife.desc: A working knife. Most of what it meets is softer than it. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillsteel_dirk.name: Stillsteel Dirk
stillsteel_dirk.desc: A dirk ground thin enough to slip between plates. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillsteel_blade.name: Stillsteel Blade
stillsteel_blade.desc: An issue sword: stamped, numbered, dependable. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillsteel_sword.name: Stillsteel Sword
stillsteel_sword.desc: A long one-handed sword with a quiet edge. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillsteel_axe.name: Stillsteel Axe
stillsteel_axe.desc: A hatchet grown up. It opens what it hits. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillsteel_bearded_axe.name: Stillsteel Bearded Axe
stillsteel_bearded_axe.desc: A broad bearded head on a short haft. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillsteel_mace.name: Stillsteel Mace
stillsteel_mace.desc: A mace for things wearing more than you are. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillsteel_warhammer.name: Stillsteel Warhammer
stillsteel_warhammer.desc: A short warhammer, weighted forward. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillsteel_spear.name: Stillsteel Spear
stillsteel_spear.desc: A plain spear on a long haft. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillsteel_partisan.name: Stillsteel Partisan
stillsteel_partisan.desc: A partisan built to hold a doorway. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillsteel_maul.name: Stillsteel Maul
stillsteel_maul.desc: A great maul: both hands, all of your attention. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillsteel_greatsword.name: Stillsteel Greatsword
stillsteel_greatsword.desc: A two-handed blade with a ricasso to choke up on. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillsteel_throwing_knives.name: Stillsteel Throwing Knives
stillsteel_throwing_knives.desc: Throwing knives in a bandolier, weighted at the tip. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillsteel_javelins.name: Stillsteel Javelins
stillsteel_javelins.desc: A quiver of javelins with long iron shanks. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

still_silk_sling.name: Still-Silk Sling
still_silk_sling.desc: A braided sling that never runs out of stones. Still-silk makes no sound, moving or not.

wyrmhide_staff_sling.name: Wyrmhide Staff Sling
wyrmhide_staff_sling.desc: A sling on a pole; it throws a stone the size of a fist. Wyrmhide was cut from something that lived under a mountain.

stillwood_bow.name: Stillwood Bow
stillwood_bow.desc: A plain self bow. Stand still and it pays. Stillwood does not warp, crack or forgive.

stillwood_recurve.name: Stillwood Recurve
stillwood_recurve.desc: A war recurve, short enough to turn with. Stillwood does not warp, crack or forgive.

stillwood_crossbow.name: Stillwood Crossbow
stillwood_crossbow.desc: A crossbow spanned by a lever, one bolt at a time. Stillwood does not warp, crack or forgive.

stillwood_arbalest.name: Stillwood Arbalest
stillwood_arbalest.desc: A heavy arbalest; the windlass hangs at the hip. Stillwood does not warp, crack or forgive.

stillsteel_flue.name: Stillsteel Flue
stillsteel_flue.desc: A plain flue: you cast, it vents, something falls over. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillsteel_long_flue.name: Stillsteel Long Flue
stillsteel_long_flue.desc: A long-barrelled flue, runed along every seam. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillsteel_buckler.name: Stillsteel Buckler
stillsteel_buckler.desc: A fist-sized boss with a rim. Quick, not deep. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillwood_shield.name: Stillwood Shield
stillwood_shield.desc: A plain shield. It takes what it is given. Stillwood does not warp, crack or forgive.

stillsteel_heater_shield.name: Stillsteel Heater Shield
stillsteel_heater_shield.desc: A banded heater shield with a fitted grip. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillsteel_sump.name: Stillsteel Sump
stillsteel_sump.desc: A squat sump-jar. It hums when it is full. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillsteel_tablet.name: Stillsteel Tablet
stillsteel_tablet.desc: A runed tablet: someone else's working, and theirs was better. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

still_silk_hood.name: Still-Silk Hood
still_silk_hood.desc: A close hood; it breathes. Still-silk makes no sound, moving or not.

still_silk_jack.name: Still-Silk Jack
still_silk_jack.desc: A padded jack, quilted in diamonds. Still-silk makes no sound, moving or not.

still_silk_gloves.name: Still-Silk Gloves
still_silk_gloves.desc: Thin gloves, close at the wrist. Still-silk makes no sound, moving or not.

still_silk_runners.name: Still-Silk Runners
still_silk_runners.desc: Light shoes for people who are paid to arrive. Still-silk makes no sound, moving or not.

still_silk_long_coat.name: Still-Silk Long Coat
still_silk_long_coat.desc: A delving coat cut long, with a hood rolled at the collar. Still-silk makes no sound, moving or not.

wyrmhide_cap.name: Wyrmhide Cap
wyrmhide_cap.desc: A stiff cap with a brow-band. Wyrmhide was cut from something that lived under a mountain.

wyrmhide_cuirass.name: Wyrmhide Cuirass
wyrmhide_cuirass.desc: A moulded leather cuirass laced at the side. Wyrmhide was cut from something that lived under a mountain.

wyrmhide_bracers.name: Wyrmhide Bracers
wyrmhide_bracers.desc: Laced bracers with a rib down the forearm. Wyrmhide was cut from something that lived under a mountain.

wyrmhide_boots.name: Wyrmhide Boots
wyrmhide_boots.desc: Studded boots that grip on any floor. Wyrmhide was cut from something that lived under a mountain.

wyrmhide_brigandine.name: Wyrmhide Brigandine
wyrmhide_brigandine.desc: A fitted brigandine; every plate sits where the last blow landed. Wyrmhide was cut from something that lived under a mountain.

stillsteel_helm.name: Stillsteel Helm
stillsteel_helm.desc: A plain helm, riveted, with a nasal. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillsteel_plate.name: Stillsteel Plate
stillsteel_plate.desc: A plate cuirass with a fauld. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillsteel_gauntlets.name: Stillsteel Gauntlets
stillsteel_gauntlets.desc: Plate mitts over a leather glove. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillsteel_sabatons.name: Stillsteel Sabatons
stillsteel_sabatons.desc: Steel to the toe and plate to the knee. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

stillsteel_harness.name: Stillsteel Harness
stillsteel_harness.desc: A fitted harness. The price says so twice. Stillsteel does not ring when struck. Nothing about it wants to move.

wyrmhide_frame.name: Wyrmhide Frame
wyrmhide_frame.desc: A delving frame with a hip band and lashing points. Wyrmhide was cut from something that lived under a mountain.

wyrmhide_belt.name: Wyrmhide Belt
wyrmhide_belt.desc: A wide belt: braces, rings and a buckle you can work one-handed. Wyrmhide was cut from something that lived under a mountain.

stillsteel_tide_charm.name: Stillsteel Tide Charm
stillsteel_tide_charm.desc: A charm set with brinepearl in stillsteel. Water abilities cost less essence.

stillsteel_tide_talisman.name: Stillsteel Tide Talisman
stillsteel_tide_talisman.desc: A talisman of brinepearl bound in stillsteel wire. Water abilities hit a little harder.

stillsteel_ember_charm.name: Stillsteel Ember Charm
stillsteel_ember_charm.desc: A charm set with emberite in stillsteel. Fire abilities cost less essence.

stillsteel_ember_talisman.name: Stillsteel Ember Talisman
stillsteel_ember_talisman.desc: A talisman of emberite bound in stillsteel wire. Fire abilities hit a little harder.

stillsteel_loam_charm.desc: A charm set with loamstone in stillsteel. Earth abilities cost less essence.

stillsteel_loam_talisman.name: Stillsteel Loam Talisman
stillsteel_loam_talisman.desc: A talisman of loamstone bound in stillsteel wire. Earth abilities hit a little harder.

stillsteel_gale_charm.desc: A charm set with galequill in stillsteel. Wind abilities cost less essence.

stillsteel_gale_talisman.name: Stillsteel Gale Talisman
stillsteel_gale_talisman.desc: A talisman of galequill bound in stillsteel wire. Wind abilities hit a little harder.

stillsteel_storm_charm.desc: A charm set with fulgurite in stillsteel. Lightning abilities cost less essence.

stillsteel_storm_talisman.name: Stillsteel Storm Talisman
stillsteel_storm_talisman.desc: A talisman of fulgurite bound in stillsteel wire. Lightning abilities hit a little harder.

stillsteel_cooling_coil.name: Stillsteel Cooling Coil
stillsteel_cooling_coil.desc: A coil of stillsteel that runs cold when you run hot. Reflux bleeds off a little faster.

still_silk_menders_thread.name: Still-Silk Mender's Thread
still_silk_menders_thread.desc: A thread of still-silk soaked in hushleaf, wound round the wrist. Healing spent on a lasting wound goes further.

heptad_mote.name: Heptad Mote
heptad_mote.desc: A 7-star satellite. It trickles 7 essence a second into you whether you ask or not. Satellites are found or bought; nobody in town can make one.

hushleaf_poultice.name: Hushleaf Poultice
hushleaf_poultice.desc: Hushleaf bound in cloth. Out of a fight it returns a fifth of your health over ten seconds and speeds natural healing for five minutes. Ordinary medicine; the star does not mind.

hushleaf_salve.name: Hushleaf Salve
hushleaf_salve.desc: Rubbed into your oldest lasting wound, it does 58 points of the healing that wound is waiting for. Slower than the bonesetter, and you can carry it.

still_regrowth_draught.name: Still Regrowth Draught
still_regrowth_draught.desc: Drunk in a safe place, it grows back a lost arm over the night. It itches for a week.

still_fern_draught.name: Still Fern Draught
still_fern_draught.desc: 210 essence, now. It leaves 15 reflux on every affinity, and the delve teaches you a little less.

choir_reed_paste.name: Choir Reed Paste
choir_reed_paste.desc: Cold, grey and smelling of pennies. Takes 48 reflux off every affinity. The delve teaches you a little less for it.

still_numbing_salt.name: Still Numbing Salt
still_numbing_salt.desc: For 90 seconds your wounds cost you nothing. Then each one is a tenth deeper, and the delve teaches you a little less.

still_iron_tonic.name: Still Iron Tonic
still_iron_tonic.desc: An alchemist's strength tonic. Two minutes of strikes 16% harder, then two minutes of strikes a tenth weaker. The delve teaches you a little less.

still_pale_tincture.name: Still Pale Tincture
still_pale_tincture.desc: An ascension aid. It pours blank growth into your newest star. The star fills; what it fills with is nobody in particular. Too many and the talent itself starts to wear.

still_bleeding_oil.name: Still Bleeding Oil
still_bleeding_oil.desc: Wiped on an edge: for 26 base strikes each hit opens one more bleeding stack.

still_lead_lacquer.name: Still Lead Lacquer
still_lead_lacquer.desc: A heavy lacquer for a weapon's head. For 20 base strikes they break poise half again as fast.

still_smoke_pot.name: Still Smoke Pot
still_smoke_pot.desc: Thrown: a bank of smoke three metres across. Nothing shoots through it.

still_tether_incense.name: Still Tether Incense
still_tether_incense.desc: Burned before you sit: your next projection strays 6 metres further from the body.

still_binding_salts.name: Still Binding Salts
still_binding_salts.desc: Scattered in a circle before a binding: the next binding of a construct is a little likelier to hold.

still_trail_ration.name: Still Trail Ration
still_trail_ration.desc: Hard bread, dried fruit and something salted. For an hour of the clock natural healing runs a quarter faster.

bright_brine_charge.name: Bright Brine Charge
bright_brine_charge.desc: Your next three water skills shove 60% further. Only for someone with the water affinity. The delve teaches you a little less.

bright_pitch_wick.name: Bright Pitch Wick
bright_pitch_wick.desc: For ten seconds your Heat counts as 35 reflux higher than it is, without the reflux. Only for someone with the fire affinity. The delve teaches you a little less.

bright_masons_grit.name: Bright Mason's Grit
bright_masons_grit.desc: Your next two standing stones have 80% more life and stand half as long again. Only for someone with the earth affinity. The delve teaches you a little less.

bright_gale_quill.name: Bright Gale Quill
bright_gale_quill.desc: 7 Slipstream pips at once. Only for someone with the wind affinity. The delve teaches you a little less.

bright_charged_filament.name: Bright Charged Filament
bright_charged_filament.desc: Your next three lightning hits leave 3 marks instead of one. Only for someone with the lightning affinity. The delve teaches you a little less.

bright_ether_sliver.name: Bright Ether Sliver
bright_ether_sliver.desc: A sliver of settled ether that burns in place of your stars: your next skill's essence cost, up to 84, is paid from it. Its reflux is still yours. The delve teaches you a little less.

stillsteel_tipped_arrows.name: Stillsteel-Tipped Arrows
stillsteel_tipped_arrows.desc: Twenty arrows with stillsteel heads. About half come back.

stillsteel_bolts.name: Stillsteel Bolts
stillsteel_bolts.desc: Twelve short bolts, stillsteel to the shoulder. Most can be dug out.

stillsteel_shot.name: Stillsteel Shot
stillsteel_shot.desc: Thirty cast stillsteel bullets for a sling. Gone once thrown.

stillsteel_barbed_arrows.name: Stillsteel Barbed Arrows
stillsteel_barbed_arrows.desc: Twelve barbed arrows. They do not come out the way they went in, so they do not come back.

stillsteel_bodkins.name: Stillsteel Bodkins
stillsteel_bodkins.desc: Twelve square-headed arrows for armour. Front armour and shields count half against them.

stillsteel_blunt_bolts.name: Stillsteel Blunt Bolts
stillsteel_blunt_bolts.desc: Twelve bolts with heavy blunt heads. They break poise, not skin, and nearly all come back.

spoils_strongbox_b7.name: Still Strongbox
spoils_strongbox_b7.desc: Passage spoils, locked and heavy. The counting-house in town opens it and pays.

spoils_relics_b7.name: Still Relic Case
spoils_relics_b7.desc: Passage spoils: odd small things the passage gave up. They sell.

spoils_salvage_b7.name: Still Salvage
spoils_salvage_b7.desc: Passage spoils: scrap worth having. It sells.

silenced_bell.name: Silenced Bell
silenced_bell.desc: Soaked through at the middle of a slaughter. Carry it while you project: what waits is more likely to be a asura.
