key_writ_b7.desc: Placeholder: the entry writ for an owned passage rated for 7 stars. Bought at that region's ticket hall.

twinned_elk_hide.name: Twinned Elk Hide
twinned_elk_hide.desc: An elk that stands in both planes. Only half its hide came with you. Tanned, it is the band's leather.

echo_hound_fang.name: Echo Hound Fang
echo_hound_fang.desc: It bites twice: once here, once in the Netherecho. A crafter's masterwork piece for bows, slings and coats.

echo_moth_floss.name: Echo Moth Floss
echo_moth_floss.desc: Floss from a moth that is in two places. Weigh it twice. Spun, it is the band's cloth.

engine_escapement.name: Echo Engine Escapement
engine_escapement.desc: The heart of a made engine that ran in both planes. It ticks out of step. A smith's masterwork piece; the metal is the band's own.

counterpart_mask.name: Counterpart's Mask
counterpart_mask.desc: The mask of a thing that copied whoever fought it. Yours, for a while. Good only for selling, and very good for that.

echo_iron_ore.name: Echo-Iron Ore
echo_iron_ore.desc: Ore of echo-iron, from veins and resource caches. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_ash_log.name: Echo-Ash Log
echo_ash_log.desc: A length of echo-ash, felled and trimmed. Echo-ash is the same tree in two places at once.

ether_salt_b8.name: Echoing Ether Salt
ether_salt_b8.desc: Plain ether that pooled and crystallised in rich ground. Flux for smiths, base for alchemists, ink for runesetters.

echo_sorrel.name: Echo Sorrel
echo_sorrel.desc: Echo Sorrel. Pressed into a wound it pulls the edges toward each other. Apothecaries buy it by the bunch.

twin_thistle.name: Twin Thistle
twin_thistle.desc: Twin Thistle. Bitter enough to make an essence draught taste of something worse. The base of most draughts.

mirror_moss.name: Mirror Moss
mirror_moss.desc: Mirror Moss. Cold to hold in any weather. Alchemists use it to draw heat out of a paste.

doubled_plum.name: Doubled Plum
doubled_plum.desc: Doubled Plum. Grown in a resource cache that puts it back every reset. Elixir makers pay for it.

echo_iron_bar.name: Echo-Iron Bar
echo_iron_bar.desc: A bar of echo-iron. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_iron_wire.name: Echo-Iron Wire
echo_iron_wire.desc: Drawn echo-iron wire. It holds grips, rims and rings together.

twinhide_leather.name: Twinhide Leather
twinhide_leather.desc: Tanned and cut into working sides. Twinhide: the other half of the beast is still in the Netherecho.

echo_ash_stave.name: Echo-Ash Stave
echo_ash_stave.desc: Split, seasoned and straight. Echo-ash is the same tree in two places at once.

echo_floss_bolt.name: Echo-Floss Bolt
echo_floss_bolt.desc: A bolt of woven cloth. Echo-floss is woven in two places; only one of them is here.

rune_ink_b8.name: Echoing Rune Ink
rune_ink_b8.desc: Enough ink to write one rune onto one thing of this band. The runesetter does not give refunds.

echo_iron_knuckles.name: Echo-Iron Knuckles
echo_iron_knuckles.desc: A pair of knuckle-bars for working hands. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_iron_dusters.name: Echo-Iron Dusters
echo_iron_dusters.desc: Dusters with a ridge for each knuckle, fitted close. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_iron_knife.name: Echo-Iron Knife
echo_iron_knife.desc: A plain knife, long enough to matter. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_iron_dirk.name: Echo-Iron Dirk
echo_iron_dirk.desc: A narrow dirk for finding the gap. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_iron_blade.name: Echo-Iron Blade
echo_iron_blade.desc: A one-handed sword, plain and honest. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_iron_sword.name: Echo-Iron Sword
echo_iron_sword.desc: A balanced sword made by someone who fought with one. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_iron_axe.name: Echo-Iron Axe
echo_iron_axe.desc: A one-handed axe. The cut keeps working after it lands. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_iron_bearded_axe.name: Echo-Iron Bearded Axe
echo_iron_bearded_axe.desc: A bearded axe, hooked for shields and ankles. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_iron_mace.name: Echo-Iron Mace
echo_iron_mace.desc: A flanged mace. It does not care which flange arrives. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_iron_warhammer.name: Echo-Iron Warhammer
echo_iron_warhammer.desc: A warhammer with a beak behind the face. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_iron_spear.name: Echo-Iron Spear
echo_iron_spear.desc: A spear: be further away than the other one. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_iron_partisan.name: Echo-Iron Partisan
echo_iron_partisan.desc: A partisan with a broad head and side lugs. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_iron_maul.name: Echo-Iron Maul
echo_iron_maul.desc: A two-handed maul. One swing, one decision. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_iron_greatsword.name: Echo-Iron Greatsword
echo_iron_greatsword.desc: A greatsword long enough to need its own plan. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_iron_throwing_knives.name: Echo-Iron Throwing Knives
echo_iron_throwing_knives.desc: A roll of six balanced throwing knives. Most come back. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_iron_javelins.name: Echo-Iron Javelins
echo_iron_javelins.desc: Three short javelins. Each goes through the first thing. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_floss_sling.name: Echo-Floss Sling
echo_floss_sling.desc: A sling: a cord, a pouch and whatever is on the ground. Echo-floss is woven in two places; only one of them is here.

twinhide_staff_sling.name: Twinhide Staff Sling
twinhide_staff_sling.desc: A staff sling for throwing over walls. Twinhide: the other half of the beast is still in the Netherecho.

echo_ash_bow.name: Echo-Ash Bow
echo_ash_bow.desc: A hunting bow with a long, easy draw. Echo-ash is the same tree in two places at once.

echo_ash_recurve.name: Echo-Ash Recurve
echo_ash_recurve.desc: A recurve that holds its draw. Echo-ash is the same tree in two places at once.

echo_ash_crossbow.name: Echo-Ash Crossbow
echo_ash_crossbow.desc: A lever crossbow. It does not care how many stars you have. Echo-ash is the same tree in two places at once.

echo_ash_arbalest.name: Echo-Ash Arbalest
echo_ash_arbalest.desc: An arbalest with a crank. One very final noise. Echo-ash is the same tree in two places at once.

echo_iron_flue.name: Echo-Iron Flue
echo_iron_flue.desc: A runed pipe that coughs your own reflux out as shot. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_iron_long_flue.name: Echo-Iron Long Flue
echo_iron_long_flue.desc: A long flue with tight seams; less of the heat comes back up your arm. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_iron_buckler.name: Echo-Iron Buckler
echo_iron_buckler.desc: A small round buckler, back in place before the next blow. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_ash_shield.name: Echo-Ash Shield
echo_ash_shield.desc: A round shield of planks with a boss. Echo-ash is the same tree in two places at once.

echo_iron_heater_shield.name: Echo-Iron Heater Shield
echo_iron_heater_shield.desc: A heater shield, rimmed and faced. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_iron_sump.name: Echo-Iron Sump
echo_iron_sump.desc: A stoppered sump: some of what your casting leaves settles in it instead of you. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_iron_tablet.name: Echo-Iron Tablet
echo_iron_tablet.desc: A focus tablet with a working written on it. Fewer mistakes, less waste. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_floss_hood.name: Echo-Floss Hood
echo_floss_hood.desc: A hood that sheds rain and a little heat. Echo-floss is woven in two places; only one of them is here.

echo_floss_jack.name: Echo-Floss Jack
echo_floss_jack.desc: A quilted jack. It breathes, which matters more than you think. Echo-floss is woven in two places; only one of them is here.

echo_floss_gloves.name: Echo-Floss Gloves
echo_floss_gloves.desc: Soft gloves; you can feel the grip. Echo-floss is woven in two places; only one of them is here.

echo_floss_runners.name: Echo-Floss Runners
echo_floss_runners.desc: Soft runners with no heel and no noise. Echo-floss is woven in two places; only one of them is here.

echo_floss_long_coat.name: Echo-Floss Long Coat
echo_floss_long_coat.desc: A long coat, waxed, vented and mostly pockets. Echo-floss is woven in two places; only one of them is here.

twinhide_cap.name: Twinhide Cap
twinhide_cap.desc: A boiled cap, cooked until it gave up being skin. Twinhide: the other half of the beast is still in the Netherecho.

twinhide_cuirass.name: Twinhide Cuirass
twinhide_cuirass.desc: A cuirass of boiled leather, stiff as a door for the first month. Twinhide: the other half of the beast is still in the Netherecho.

twinhide_bracers.name: Twinhide Bracers
twinhide_bracers.desc: Bracers between an edge and the arm you need. Twinhide: the other half of the beast is still in the Netherecho.

twinhide_boots.name: Twinhide Boots
twinhide_boots.desc: Hobnailed boots. You stay where you stood. Twinhide: the other half of the beast is still in the Netherecho.

twinhide_brigandine.name: Twinhide Brigandine
twinhide_brigandine.desc: A brigandine: plates riveted inside a leather coat. Twinhide: the other half of the beast is still in the Netherecho.

echo_iron_helm.name: Echo-Iron Helm
echo_iron_helm.desc: A helm with a brim for things falling off walls. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_iron_plate.name: Echo-Iron Plate
echo_iron_plate.desc: Plate front and back. The heat has nowhere to go, and neither do you. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_iron_gauntlets.name: Echo-Iron Gauntlets
echo_iron_gauntlets.desc: Gauntlets with no fingers to lose track of. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_iron_sabatons.name: Echo-Iron Sabatons
echo_iron_sabatons.desc: Sabatons. Stairs become a negotiation. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

echo_iron_harness.name: Echo-Iron Harness
echo_iron_harness.desc: A full harness, measured for you. Echo-iron casts a shadow in the Netherecho as well as here.

twinhide_frame.name: Twinhide Frame
twinhide_frame.desc: A load-bearing frame for hauling corpses out. Twinhide: the other half of the beast is still in the Netherecho.

twinhide_belt.name: Twinhide Belt
twinhide_belt.desc: A belt with loops for what you want without looking. Twinhide: the other half of the beast is still in the Netherecho.

echo_iron_tide_charm.name: Echo-Iron Tide Charm
echo_iron_tide_charm.desc: A charm set with brinepearl in echo-iron. Water abilities cost less essence.

echo_iron_tide_talisman.name: Echo-Iron Tide Talisman
echo_iron_tide_talisman.desc: A talisman of brinepearl bound in echo-iron wire. Water abilities hit a little harder.

echo_iron_ember_charm.name: Echo-Iron Ember Charm
echo_iron_ember_charm.desc: A charm set with emberite in echo-iron. Fire abilities cost less essence.

echo_iron_ember_talisman.name: Echo-Iron Ember Talisman
echo_iron_ember_talisman.desc: A talisman of emberite bound in echo-iron wire. Fire abilities hit a little harder.

echo_iron_loam_charm.name: Echo-Iron Loam Charm
echo_iron_loam_charm.desc: A charm set with loamstone in echo-iron. Earth abilities cost less essence.

echo_iron_loam_talisman.name: Echo-Iron Loam Talisman
echo_iron_loam_talisman.desc: A talisman of loamstone bound in echo-iron wire. Earth abilities hit a little harder.

echo_iron_gale_charm.name: Echo-Iron Gale Charm
echo_iron_gale_charm.desc: A charm set with galequill in echo-iron. Wind abilities cost less essence.

echo_iron_gale_talisman.name: Echo-Iron Gale Talisman
echo_iron_gale_talisman.desc: A talisman of galequill bound in echo-iron wire. Wind abilities hit a little harder.

echo_iron_storm_charm.name: Echo-Iron Storm Charm
echo_iron_storm_charm.desc: A charm set with fulgurite in echo-iron. Lightning abilities cost less essence.

echo_iron_storm_talisman.name: Echo-Iron Storm Talisman
echo_iron_storm_talisman.desc: A talisman of fulgurite bound in echo-iron wire. Lightning abilities hit a little harder.

echo_iron_cooling_coil.name: Echo-Iron Cooling Coil
echo_iron_cooling_coil.desc: A coil of echo-iron that runs cold when you run hot. Reflux bleeds off a little faster.

echo_floss_menders_thread.name: Echo-Floss Mender's Thread
echo_floss_menders_thread.desc: A thread of echo-floss soaked in echo sorrel, wound round the wrist. Healing spent on a lasting wound goes further.

octad_mote.name: Octad Mote
octad_mote.desc: A 8-star satellite. It trickles 8 essence a second into you whether you ask or not. Satellites are found or bought; nobody in town can make one.

echo_sorrel_poultice.name: Echo Sorrel Poultice
echo_sorrel_poultice.desc: Echo Sorrel bound in cloth. Out of a fight it returns a fifth of your health over ten seconds and speeds natural healing for five minutes. Ordinary medicine; the star does not mind.

echo_sorrel_salve.name: Echo Sorrel Salve
echo_sorrel_salve.desc: Rubbed into your oldest lasting wound, it does 75 points of the healing that wound is waiting for. Slower than the bonesetter, and you can carry it.

echoing_clotting_powder.name: Echoing Clotting Powder
echoing_clotting_powder.desc: Thrown into a wound mid-fight: bleeding stops, and the next wound you take is a quarter shallower.

twin_thistle_draught.name: Twin Thistle Draught
twin_thistle_draught.desc: 240 essence, now. It leaves 15 reflux on every affinity, and the delve teaches you a little less.

mirror_moss_paste.name: Mirror Moss Paste
mirror_moss_paste.desc: Cold, grey and smelling of pennies. Takes 51 reflux off every affinity. The delve teaches you a little less for it.

echoing_steadying_tonic.name: Echoing Steadying Tonic
echoing_steadying_tonic.desc: Two minutes of steadier feet (more poise), then a minute of wobbling. The delve teaches you a little less.

echoing_yard_liniment.name: Echoing Yard Liniment
echoing_yard_liniment.desc: Rubbed in before a tempering session: the strain it leaves is smaller, and so is what you learn.

echoing_pale_tincture.name: Echoing Pale Tincture
echoing_pale_tincture.desc: An ascension aid. It pours blank growth into your newest star. The star fills; what it fills with is nobody in particular. Too many and the talent itself starts to wear.

echoing_blank_draught.name: Echoing Blank Draught
echoing_blank_draught.desc: A soul elixir from a clinic. It patches soul damage with blank tissue. For small cracks, nobody notices; for big ones, slowly, you become someone else.

echoing_sap_venom.name: Echoing Sap Venom
echoing_sap_venom.desc: For 15 base strikes each hit poisons for 53.0 a second over five seconds. Poison you laid pays your talent like any other harm.

echoing_caltrops.name: Echoing Caltrops
echoing_caltrops.desc: Thrown: a spray of spikes. Anything walking through them goes four-tenths slower.

echoing_second_skin_wax.name: Echoing Second-Skin Wax
echoing_second_skin_wax.desc: Rubbed on the temples: your next projection has 6 more life.

echo_iron_tipped_arrows.name: Echo-Iron-Tipped Arrows
echo_iron_tipped_arrows.desc: Twenty arrows with echo-iron heads. About half come back.

echo_iron_bolts.name: Echo-Iron Bolts
echo_iron_bolts.desc: Twelve short bolts, echo-iron to the shoulder. Most can be dug out.

echo_iron_shot.name: Echo-Iron Shot
echo_iron_shot.desc: Thirty cast echo-iron bullets for a sling. Gone once thrown.

spoils_strongbox_b8.name: Echoing Strongbox
spoils_strongbox_b8.desc: Passage spoils, locked and heavy. The counting-house in town opens it and pays.

spoils_relics_b8.name: Echoing Relic Case
spoils_relics_b8.desc: Passage spoils: odd small things the passage gave up. They sell.

spoils_salvage_b8.name: Echoing Salvage
spoils_salvage_b8.desc: Passage spoils: scrap worth having. It sells.

doubled_skull.name: Doubled Skull
doubled_skull.desc: Soaked through at the middle of a slaughter. Carry it while you project: what waits is more likely to be a asura.

key_writ_b8.name: Echoing Passage Writ
key_writ_b8.desc: Placeholder: the entry writ for an owned passage rated for 8 stars. Bought at that region's ticket hall.

imprint_toll_bell.name: Spirit Imprint: Toll Bell
imprint_toll_bell.desc: Spoken aloud: every enemy within 10 m loses half its poise; the price is a lasting wound on you. A spirit ability: it always has a price, and holding one slows the next star.

concord_stone.name: Concord Stone
concord_stone.desc: Placeholder (sets are parked): fuses 3 items into a set that shares a bonus. Needs a master artificer, and does not always take.

crag_giant_hide.name: Crag Giant Hide
crag_giant_hide.desc: A strip of hide off a giant-class thing. A strip is what one person carries. Tanned, it is the band's leather.

sky_ray_spine.name: Sky Ray Spine
sky_ray_spine.desc: A tail spine off a ray that swims in the air. Still venomous. A crafter's masterwork piece for bows, slings and coats.

heartsilk_cocoon.name: Heartsilk Cocoon
heartsilk_cocoon.desc: A cocoon that beats slowly in the hand. Spin it before it stops. Spun, it is the band's cloth.

warden_heartplate.name: Throne Warden Heartplate
warden_heartplate.desc: The chest-plate of a made warden that guarded an empty throne. A smith's masterwork piece; the metal is the band's own.

matriarch_torc.name: Crag Matriarch's Torc
matriarch_torc.desc: A neck-ring a giant wore. You could wear it as a belt. Good only for selling, and very good for that.

heartmetal_ore.name: Heartmetal Ore
heartmetal_ore.desc: Ore of heartmetal, from veins and resource caches. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

crownroot_log.name: Crownroot Log
crownroot_log.desc: A length of crownroot, felled and trimmed. Crownroot: the root of a tree nobody has seen the top of.

ether_salt_b9.name: Heart-Sealed Ether Salt
ether_salt_b9.desc: Plain ether that pooled and crystallised in rich ground. Flux for smiths, base for alchemists, ink for runesetters.

crag_ease.name: Crag Ease
crag_ease.desc: Crag Ease. Pressed into a wound it pulls the edges toward each other. Apothecaries buy it by the bunch.

giants_pepper.name: Giant's Pepper
giants_pepper.desc: Giant's Pepper. Bitter enough to make an essence draught taste of something worse. The base of most draughts.

ray_kelp.name: Ray Kelp
ray_kelp.desc: Ray Kelp. Cold to hold in any weather. Alchemists use it to draw heat out of a paste.

summit_fig.name: Summit Fig
summit_fig.desc: Summit Fig. Grown in a resource cache that puts it back every reset. Elixir makers pay for it.

heartmetal_bar.name: Heartmetal Bar
heartmetal_bar.desc: A bar of heartmetal. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartmetal_wire.name: Heartmetal Wire
heartmetal_wire.desc: Drawn heartmetal wire. It holds grips, rims and rings together.

gianthide_leather.name: Gianthide Leather
gianthide_leather.desc: Tanned and cut into working sides. Gianthide, a hand thick. One beast dresses a company.

crownroot_stave.name: Crownroot Stave
crownroot_stave.desc: Split, seasoned and straight. Crownroot: the root of a tree nobody has seen the top of.

heartsilk_bolt.name: Heartsilk Bolt
heartsilk_bolt.desc: A bolt of woven cloth. Heartsilk: each thread is a long breath, held.

rune_ink_b9.name: Heart-Sealed Rune Ink
rune_ink_b9.desc: Enough ink to write one rune onto one thing of this band. The runesetter does not give refunds.

singing_brinepearl.name: Singing Brinepearl
singing_brinepearl.desc: Water ether that pooled and set in rich ground, singing all the way through. Charms, talismans and charges are made of it.

singing_emberite.name: Singing Emberite
singing_emberite.desc: Fire ether that pooled and set in rich ground, singing all the way through. Charms, talismans and charges are made of it.

singing_loamstone.name: Singing Loamstone
singing_loamstone.desc: Earth ether that pooled and set in rich ground, singing all the way through. Charms, talismans and charges are made of it.

singing_galequill.name: Singing Galequill
singing_galequill.desc: Wind ether that pooled and set in rich ground, singing all the way through. Charms, talismans and charges are made of it.

singing_fulgurite.name: Singing Fulgurite
singing_fulgurite.desc: Lightning ether that pooled and set in rich ground, singing all the way through. Charms, talismans and charges are made of it.

heartmetal_knuckles.name: Heartmetal Knuckles
heartmetal_knuckles.desc: Your fists, with an argument added. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartmetal_dusters.name: Heartmetal Dusters
heartmetal_dusters.desc: Close-fitted dusters, every edge filed to your grip. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartmetal_knife.name: Heartmetal Knife
heartmetal_knife.desc: A working knife. Most of what it meets is softer than it. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartmetal_dirk.name: Heartmetal Dirk
heartmetal_dirk.desc: A dirk ground thin enough to slip between plates. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartmetal_blade.name: Heartmetal Blade
heartmetal_blade.desc: An issue sword: stamped, numbered, dependable. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartmetal_sword.name: Heartmetal Sword
heartmetal_sword.desc: A long one-handed sword with a quiet edge. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartmetal_axe.name: Heartmetal Axe
heartmetal_axe.desc: A hatchet grown up. It opens what it hits. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartmetal_bearded_axe.name: Heartmetal Bearded Axe
heartmetal_bearded_axe.desc: A broad bearded head on a short haft. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartmetal_mace.name: Heartmetal Mace
heartmetal_mace.desc: A mace for things wearing more than you are. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartmetal_warhammer.name: Heartmetal Warhammer
heartmetal_warhammer.desc: A short warhammer, weighted forward. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartmetal_spear.name: Heartmetal Spear
heartmetal_spear.desc: A plain spear on a long haft. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartmetal_partisan.name: Heartmetal Partisan
heartmetal_partisan.desc: A partisan built to hold a doorway. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartmetal_maul.name: Heartmetal Maul
heartmetal_maul.desc: A great maul: both hands, all of your attention. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartmetal_greatsword.name: Heartmetal Greatsword
heartmetal_greatsword.desc: A two-handed blade with a ricasso to choke up on. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartmetal_throwing_knives.name: Heartmetal Throwing Knives
heartmetal_throwing_knives.desc: Throwing knives in a bandolier, weighted at the tip. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartmetal_javelins.name: Heartmetal Javelins
heartmetal_javelins.desc: A quiver of javelins with long iron shanks. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartsilk_sling.name: Heartsilk Sling
heartsilk_sling.desc: A braided sling that never runs out of stones. Heartsilk: each thread is a long breath, held.

gianthide_staff_sling.name: Gianthide Staff Sling
gianthide_staff_sling.desc: A sling on a pole; it throws a stone the size of a fist. Gianthide, a hand thick. One beast dresses a company.

crownroot_bow.name: Crownroot Bow
crownroot_bow.desc: A plain self bow. Stand still and it pays. Crownroot: the root of a tree nobody has seen the top of.

crownroot_recurve.name: Crownroot Recurve
crownroot_recurve.desc: A war recurve, short enough to turn with. Crownroot: the root of a tree nobody has seen the top of.

crownroot_crossbow.name: Crownroot Crossbow
crownroot_crossbow.desc: A crossbow spanned by a lever, one bolt at a time. Crownroot: the root of a tree nobody has seen the top of.

crownroot_arbalest.name: Crownroot Arbalest
crownroot_arbalest.desc: A heavy arbalest; the windlass hangs at the hip. Crownroot: the root of a tree nobody has seen the top of.

heartmetal_flue.name: Heartmetal Flue
heartmetal_flue.desc: A plain flue: you cast, it vents, something falls over. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartmetal_long_flue.name: Heartmetal Long Flue
heartmetal_long_flue.desc: A long-barrelled flue, runed along every seam. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartmetal_buckler.name: Heartmetal Buckler
heartmetal_buckler.desc: A fist-sized boss with a rim. Quick, not deep. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

crownroot_shield.name: Crownroot Shield
crownroot_shield.desc: A plain shield. It takes what it is given. Crownroot: the root of a tree nobody has seen the top of.

heartmetal_heater_shield.name: Heartmetal Heater Shield
heartmetal_heater_shield.desc: A banded heater shield with a fitted grip. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartmetal_sump.name: Heartmetal Sump
heartmetal_sump.desc: A squat sump-jar. It hums when it is full. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartmetal_tablet.name: Heartmetal Tablet
heartmetal_tablet.desc: A runed tablet: someone else's working, and theirs was better. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartsilk_hood.name: Heartsilk Hood
heartsilk_hood.desc: A close hood; it breathes. Heartsilk: each thread is a long breath, held.

heartsilk_jack.name: Heartsilk Jack
heartsilk_jack.desc: A padded jack, quilted in diamonds. Heartsilk: each thread is a long breath, held.

heartsilk_gloves.name: Heartsilk Gloves
heartsilk_gloves.desc: Thin gloves, close at the wrist. Heartsilk: each thread is a long breath, held.

heartsilk_runners.name: Heartsilk Runners
heartsilk_runners.desc: Light shoes for people who are paid to arrive. Heartsilk: each thread is a long breath, held.

heartsilk_long_coat.name: Heartsilk Long Coat
heartsilk_long_coat.desc: A delving coat cut long, with a hood rolled at the collar. Heartsilk: each thread is a long breath, held.

gianthide_cap.name: Gianthide Cap
gianthide_cap.desc: A stiff cap with a brow-band. Gianthide, a hand thick. One beast dresses a company.

gianthide_cuirass.name: Gianthide Cuirass
gianthide_cuirass.desc: A moulded leather cuirass laced at the side. Gianthide, a hand thick. One beast dresses a company.

gianthide_bracers.name: Gianthide Bracers
gianthide_bracers.desc: Laced bracers with a rib down the forearm. Gianthide, a hand thick. One beast dresses a company.

gianthide_boots.name: Gianthide Boots
gianthide_boots.desc: Studded boots that grip on any floor. Gianthide, a hand thick. One beast dresses a company.

gianthide_brigandine.name: Gianthide Brigandine
gianthide_brigandine.desc: A fitted brigandine; every plate sits where the last blow landed. Gianthide, a hand thick. One beast dresses a company.

heartmetal_helm.name: Heartmetal Helm
heartmetal_helm.desc: A plain helm, riveted, with a nasal. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartmetal_plate.name: Heartmetal Plate
heartmetal_plate.desc: A plate cuirass with a fauld. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartmetal_gauntlets.name: Heartmetal Gauntlets
heartmetal_gauntlets.desc: Plate mitts over a leather glove. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartmetal_sabatons.name: Heartmetal Sabatons
heartmetal_sabatons.desc: Steel to the toe and plate to the knee. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

heartmetal_harness.name: Heartmetal Harness
heartmetal_harness.desc: A fitted harness. The price says so twice. Heartmetal comes from the middle of realms that were holding on to it.

gianthide_frame.name: Gianthide Frame
gianthide_frame.desc: A delving frame with a hip band and lashing points. Gianthide, a hand thick. One beast dresses a company.

gianthide_belt.name: Gianthide Belt
gianthide_belt.desc: A wide belt: braces, rings and a buckle you can work one-handed. Gianthide, a hand thick. One beast dresses a company.

heartmetal_tide_charm.name: Heartmetal Tide Charm
heartmetal_tide_charm.desc: A charm set with brinepearl in heartmetal. Water abilities cost less essence.

heartmetal_tide_talisman.name: Heartmetal Tide Talisman
heartmetal_tide_talisman.desc: A talisman of brinepearl bound in heartmetal wire. Water abilities hit a little harder.

heartmetal_ember_charm.name: Heartmetal Ember Charm
heartmetal_ember_charm.desc: A charm set with emberite in heartmetal. Fire abilities cost less essence.

heartmetal_ember_talisman.name: Heartmetal Ember Talisman
heartmetal_ember_talisman.desc: A talisman of emberite bound in heartmetal wire. Fire abilities hit a little harder.

heartmetal_loam_charm.name: Heartmetal Loam Charm
heartmetal_loam_charm.desc: A charm set with loamstone in heartmetal. Earth abilities cost less essence.

heartmetal_loam_talisman.name: Heartmetal Loam Talisman
heartmetal_loam_talisman.desc: A talisman of loamstone bound in heartmetal wire. Earth abilities hit a little harder.

heartmetal_gale_charm.name: Heartmetal Gale Charm
heartmetal_gale_charm.desc: A charm set with galequill in heartmetal. Wind abilities cost less essence.

heartmetal_gale_talisman.name: Heartmetal Gale Talisman
heartmetal_gale_talisman.desc: A talisman of galequill bound in heartmetal wire. Wind abilities hit a little harder.

heartmetal_storm_charm.name: Heartmetal Storm Charm
heartmetal_storm_charm.desc: A charm set with fulgurite in heartmetal. Lightning abilities cost less essence.

heartmetal_storm_talisman.name: Heartmetal Storm Talisman
heartmetal_storm_talisman.desc: A talisman of fulgurite bound in heartmetal wire. Lightning abilities hit a little harder.

heartmetal_cooling_coil.name: Heartmetal Cooling Coil
heartmetal_cooling_coil.desc: A coil of heartmetal that runs cold when you run hot. Reflux bleeds off a little faster.

heartsilk_menders_thread.name: Heartsilk Mender's Thread
heartsilk_menders_thread.desc: A thread of heartsilk soaked in crag ease, wound round the wrist. Healing spent on a lasting wound goes further.

ennead_mote.name: Ennead Mote
ennead_mote.desc: A 9-star satellite. It trickles 9 essence a second into you whether you ask or not. Satellites are found or bought; nobody in town can make one.

crag_ease_poultice.name: Crag Ease Poultice
crag_ease_poultice.desc: Crag Ease bound in cloth. Out of a fight it returns a fifth of your health over ten seconds and speeds natural healing for five minutes. Ordinary medicine; the star does not mind.

crag_ease_salve.name: Crag Ease Salve
crag_ease_salve.desc: Rubbed into your oldest lasting wound, it does 98 points of the healing that wound is waiting for. Slower than the bonesetter, and you can carry it.

giants_pepper_draught.name: Giant's Pepper Draught
giants_pepper_draught.desc: 270 essence, now. It leaves 15 reflux on every affinity, and the delve teaches you a little less.

ray_kelp_paste.name: Ray Kelp Paste
ray_kelp_paste.desc: Cold, grey and smelling of pennies. Takes 54 reflux off every affinity. The delve teaches you a little less for it.

heart_sealed_numbing_salt.name: Heart-Sealed Numbing Salt
heart_sealed_numbing_salt.desc: For 100 seconds your wounds cost you nothing. Then each one is a tenth deeper, and the delve teaches you a little less.

heart_sealed_iron_tonic.name: Heart-Sealed Iron Tonic
heart_sealed_iron_tonic.desc: An alchemist's strength tonic. Two minutes of strikes 18% harder, then two minutes of strikes a tenth weaker. The delve teaches you a little less.

heart_sealed_pale_tincture.name: Heart-Sealed Pale Tincture
heart_sealed_pale_tincture.desc: An ascension aid. It pours blank growth into your newest star. The star fills; what it fills with is nobody in particular. Too many and the talent itself starts to wear.

unbroken_crown.name: Unbroken Crown
unbroken_crown.desc: A true ascension elixir, of no known origin. It fills the newest star and makes what comes next a little more yours. Worth killing for, and people have.

heart_sealed_bleeding_oil.name: Heart-Sealed Bleeding Oil
heart_sealed_bleeding_oil.desc: Wiped on an edge: for 28 base strikes each hit opens one more bleeding stack.

heart_sealed_flash_powder.name: Heart-Sealed Flash Powder
heart_sealed_flash_powder.desc: Thrown: a white flash. Every wind-up within four metres is broken.

heart_sealed_tether_incense.name: Heart-Sealed Tether Incense
heart_sealed_tether_incense.desc: Burned before you sit: your next projection strays 7 metres further from the body.

heart_sealed_binding_salts.name: Heart-Sealed Binding Salts
heart_sealed_binding_salts.desc: Scattered in a circle before a binding: the next binding of a construct is a little likelier to hold.

heart_sealed_short_night_pill.name: Heart-Sealed Short-Night Pill
heart_sealed_short_night_pill.desc: A night's sleep in an hour. The body is rested; the mind will mention it later.

singing_brine_charge.name: Singing Brine Charge
singing_brine_charge.desc: Your next three water skills shove 70% further. Only for someone with the water affinity. The delve teaches you a little less.

singing_pitch_wick.name: Singing Pitch Wick
singing_pitch_wick.desc: For ten seconds your Heat counts as 40 reflux higher than it is, without the reflux. Only for someone with the fire affinity. The delve teaches you a little less.

singing_masons_grit.name: Singing Mason's Grit
singing_masons_grit.desc: Your next two standing stones have 90% more life and stand half as long again. Only for someone with the earth affinity. The delve teaches you a little less.

singing_gale_quill.name: Singing Gale Quill
singing_gale_quill.desc: 8 Slipstream pips at once. Only for someone with the wind affinity. The delve teaches you a little less.

singing_charged_filament.name: Singing Charged Filament
singing_charged_filament.desc: Your next three lightning hits leave 3 marks instead of one. Only for someone with the lightning affinity. The delve teaches you a little less.

singing_ether_sliver.name: Singing Ether Sliver
singing_ether_sliver.desc: A sliver of settled ether that burns in place of your stars: your next skill's essence cost, up to 108, is paid from it. Its reflux is still yours. The delve teaches you a little less.

heartmetal_tipped_arrows.name: Heartmetal-Tipped Arrows
heartmetal_tipped_arrows.desc: Twenty arrows with heartmetal heads. About half come back.

heartmetal_bolts.name: Heartmetal Bolts
heartmetal_bolts.desc: Twelve short bolts, heartmetal to the shoulder. Most can be dug out.

heartmetal_shot.name: Heartmetal Shot
heartmetal_shot.desc: Thirty cast heartmetal bullets for a sling. Gone once thrown.

spoils_strongbox_b9.name: Heart-Sealed Strongbox
spoils_strongbox_b9.desc: Passage spoils, locked and heavy. The counting-house in town opens it and pays.

spoils_relics_b9.name: Heart-Sealed Relic Case
spoils_relics_b9.desc: Passage spoils: odd small things the passage gave up. They sell.

spoils_salvage_b9.name: Heart-Sealed Salvage
spoils_salvage_b9.desc: Passage spoils: scrap worth having. It sells.

giants_last_tooth.name: Giant's Last Tooth
giants_last_tooth.desc: Soaked through at the middle of a slaughter. Carry it while you project: what waits is more likely to be a asura.

key_writ_b9.name: Heart-Sealed Passage Writ
key_writ_b9.desc: Placeholder: the entry writ for an owned passage rated for 9 stars. Bought at that region's ticket hall.

deepcoil_hide.name: Deepcoil Serpent Hide
deepcoil_hide.desc: From a serpent longer than a street. You cut the length you can carry. Tanned, it is the band's leather.

firstbone.name: Firstbone
firstbone.desc: A bone from the first beast of its kind, which was also the last. A crafter's masterwork piece for bows, slings and coats.

dawn_moth_floss.name: Dawn Moth Floss
dawn_moth_floss.desc: Gathered at a realm's first light, before the moths knew to hide it. Spun, it is the band's cloth.

unsleeping_cog.name: Unsleeping Cog
unsleeping_cog.desc: A cog from an engine that has run since before people. It is still trying. A smith's masterwork piece; the metal is the band's own.

tithe_taker_scale.name: Tithe-Taker's Scale
tithe_taker_scale.desc: The scale of the thing that weighed everything that passed it. Good only for selling, and very good for that.

firstmetal_ore.name: Firstmetal Ore
firstmetal_ore.desc: Ore of firstmetal, from veins and resource caches. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstwood_log.name: Firstwood Log
firstwood_log.desc: A length of firstwood, felled and trimmed. Firstwood remembers being the first tree.

ether_salt_b10.name: First-Struck Ether Salt
ether_salt_b10.desc: Plain ether that pooled and crystallised in rich ground. Flux for smiths, base for alchemists, ink for runesetters.

first_bloom.name: First Bloom
first_bloom.desc: First Bloom. Pressed into a wound it pulls the edges toward each other. Apothecaries buy it by the bunch.

dawn_thistle.name: Dawn Thistle
dawn_thistle.desc: Dawn Thistle. Bitter enough to make an essence draught taste of something worse. The base of most draughts.

deep_kelp.name: Deep Kelp
deep_kelp.desc: Deep Kelp. Cold to hold in any weather. Alchemists use it to draw heat out of a paste.

first_fruit.name: First Fruit
first_fruit.desc: First Fruit. Grown in a resource cache that puts it back every reset. Elixir makers pay for it.

firstmetal_bar.name: Firstmetal Bar
firstmetal_bar.desc: A bar of firstmetal. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstmetal_wire.name: Firstmetal Wire
firstmetal_wire.desc: Drawn firstmetal wire. It holds grips, rims and rings together.

coilhide_leather.name: Coilhide Leather
coilhide_leather.desc: Tanned and cut into working sides. Coilhide, from a serpent longer than a street.

firstwood_stave.name: Firstwood Stave
firstwood_stave.desc: Split, seasoned and straight. Firstwood remembers being the first tree.

dawn_floss_bolt.name: Dawn-Floss Bolt
dawn_floss_bolt.desc: A bolt of woven cloth. Dawn-floss, from moths that fly only at a realm's first light.

rune_ink_b10.name: First-Struck Rune Ink
rune_ink_b10.desc: Enough ink to write one rune onto one thing of this band. The runesetter does not give refunds.

firstmetal_knuckles.name: Firstmetal Knuckles
firstmetal_knuckles.desc: A pair of knuckle-bars for working hands. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstmetal_dusters.name: Firstmetal Dusters
firstmetal_dusters.desc: Dusters with a ridge for each knuckle, fitted close. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstmetal_knife.name: Firstmetal Knife
firstmetal_knife.desc: A plain knife, long enough to matter. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstmetal_dirk.name: Firstmetal Dirk
firstmetal_dirk.desc: A narrow dirk for finding the gap. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstmetal_blade.name: Firstmetal Blade
firstmetal_blade.desc: A one-handed sword, plain and honest. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstmetal_sword.name: Firstmetal Sword
firstmetal_sword.desc: A balanced sword made by someone who fought with one. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstmetal_axe.name: Firstmetal Axe
firstmetal_axe.desc: A one-handed axe. The cut keeps working after it lands. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstmetal_bearded_axe.name: Firstmetal Bearded Axe
firstmetal_bearded_axe.desc: A bearded axe, hooked for shields and ankles. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstmetal_mace.name: Firstmetal Mace
firstmetal_mace.desc: A flanged mace. It does not care which flange arrives. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstmetal_warhammer.name: Firstmetal Warhammer
firstmetal_warhammer.desc: A warhammer with a beak behind the face. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstmetal_spear.name: Firstmetal Spear
firstmetal_spear.desc: A spear: be further away than the other one. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstmetal_partisan.name: Firstmetal Partisan
firstmetal_partisan.desc: A partisan with a broad head and side lugs. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstmetal_maul.name: Firstmetal Maul
firstmetal_maul.desc: A two-handed maul. One swing, one decision. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstmetal_greatsword.name: Firstmetal Greatsword
firstmetal_greatsword.desc: A greatsword long enough to need its own plan. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstmetal_throwing_knives.name: Firstmetal Throwing Knives
firstmetal_throwing_knives.desc: A roll of six balanced throwing knives. Most come back. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstmetal_javelins.name: Firstmetal Javelins
firstmetal_javelins.desc: Three short javelins. Each goes through the first thing. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

dawn_floss_sling.name: Dawn-Floss Sling
dawn_floss_sling.desc: A sling: a cord, a pouch and whatever is on the ground. Dawn-floss, from moths that fly only at a realm's first light.

coilhide_staff_sling.name: Coilhide Staff Sling
coilhide_staff_sling.desc: A staff sling for throwing over walls. Coilhide, from a serpent longer than a street.

firstwood_bow.name: Firstwood Bow
firstwood_bow.desc: A hunting bow with a long, easy draw. Firstwood remembers being the first tree.

firstwood_recurve.name: Firstwood Recurve
firstwood_recurve.desc: A recurve that holds its draw. Firstwood remembers being the first tree.

firstwood_crossbow.name: Firstwood Crossbow
firstwood_crossbow.desc: A lever crossbow. It does not care how many stars you have. Firstwood remembers being the first tree.

firstwood_arbalest.name: Firstwood Arbalest
firstwood_arbalest.desc: An arbalest with a crank. One very final noise. Firstwood remembers being the first tree.

firstmetal_flue.name: Firstmetal Flue
firstmetal_flue.desc: A runed pipe that coughs your own reflux out as shot. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstmetal_long_flue.name: Firstmetal Long Flue
firstmetal_long_flue.desc: A long flue with tight seams; less of the heat comes back up your arm. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstmetal_buckler.name: Firstmetal Buckler
firstmetal_buckler.desc: A small round buckler, back in place before the next blow. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstwood_shield.name: Firstwood Shield
firstwood_shield.desc: A round shield of planks with a boss. Firstwood remembers being the first tree.

firstmetal_heater_shield.name: Firstmetal Heater Shield
firstmetal_heater_shield.desc: A heater shield, rimmed and faced. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstmetal_sump.name: Firstmetal Sump
firstmetal_sump.desc: A stoppered sump: some of what your casting leaves settles in it instead of you. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstmetal_tablet.name: Firstmetal Tablet
firstmetal_tablet.desc: A focus tablet with a working written on it. Fewer mistakes, less waste. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

dawn_floss_hood.name: Dawn-Floss Hood
dawn_floss_hood.desc: A hood that sheds rain and a little heat. Dawn-floss, from moths that fly only at a realm's first light.

dawn_floss_jack.name: Dawn-Floss Jack
dawn_floss_jack.desc: A quilted jack. It breathes, which matters more than you think. Dawn-floss, from moths that fly only at a realm's first light.

dawn_floss_gloves.name: Dawn-Floss Gloves
dawn_floss_gloves.desc: Soft gloves; you can feel the grip. Dawn-floss, from moths that fly only at a realm's first light.

dawn_floss_runners.name: Dawn-Floss Runners
dawn_floss_runners.desc: Soft runners with no heel and no noise. Dawn-floss, from moths that fly only at a realm's first light.

dawn_floss_long_coat.name: Dawn-Floss Long Coat
dawn_floss_long_coat.desc: A long coat, waxed, vented and mostly pockets. Dawn-floss, from moths that fly only at a realm's first light.

coilhide_cap.name: Coilhide Cap
coilhide_cap.desc: A boiled cap, cooked until it gave up being skin. Coilhide, from a serpent longer than a street.

coilhide_cuirass.name: Coilhide Cuirass
coilhide_cuirass.desc: A cuirass of boiled leather, stiff as a door for the first month. Coilhide, from a serpent longer than a street.

coilhide_bracers.name: Coilhide Bracers
coilhide_bracers.desc: Bracers between an edge and the arm you need. Coilhide, from a serpent longer than a street.

coilhide_boots.name: Coilhide Boots
coilhide_boots.desc: Hobnailed boots. You stay where you stood. Coilhide, from a serpent longer than a street.

coilhide_brigandine.name: Coilhide Brigandine
coilhide_brigandine.desc: A brigandine: plates riveted inside a leather coat. Coilhide, from a serpent longer than a street.

firstmetal_helm.name: Firstmetal Helm
firstmetal_helm.desc: A helm with a brim for things falling off walls. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstmetal_plate.name: Firstmetal Plate
firstmetal_plate.desc: Plate front and back. The heat has nowhere to go, and neither do you. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstmetal_gauntlets.name: Firstmetal Gauntlets
firstmetal_gauntlets.desc: Gauntlets with no fingers to lose track of. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstmetal_sabatons.name: Firstmetal Sabatons
firstmetal_sabatons.desc: Sabatons. Stairs become a negotiation. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

firstmetal_harness.name: Firstmetal Harness
firstmetal_harness.desc: A full harness, measured for you. Firstmetal is what the other metals were trying to be.

coilhide_frame.name: Coilhide Frame
coilhide_frame.desc: A load-bearing frame for hauling corpses out. Coilhide, from a serpent longer than a street.

coilhide_belt.name: Coilhide Belt
coilhide_belt.desc: A belt with loops for what you want without looking. Coilhide, from a serpent longer than a street.

firstmetal_tide_charm.name: Firstmetal Tide Charm
firstmetal_tide_charm.desc: A charm set with brinepearl in firstmetal. Water abilities cost less essence.

firstmetal_tide_talisman.name: Firstmetal Tide Talisman
firstmetal_tide_talisman.desc: A talisman of brinepearl bound in firstmetal wire. Water abilities hit a little harder.

firstmetal_ember_charm.name: Firstmetal Ember Charm
firstmetal_ember_charm.desc: A charm set with emberite in firstmetal. Fire abilities cost less essence.

firstmetal_ember_talisman.name: Firstmetal Ember Talisman
firstmetal_ember_talisman.desc: A talisman of emberite bound in firstmetal wire. Fire abilities hit a little harder.

firstmetal_loam_charm.name: Firstmetal Loam Charm
firstmetal_loam_charm.desc: A charm set with loamstone in firstmetal. Earth abilities cost less essence.

firstmetal_loam_talisman.name: Firstmetal Loam Talisman
firstmetal_loam_talisman.desc: A talisman of loamstone bound in firstmetal wire. Earth abilities hit a little harder.

firstmetal_gale_charm.name: Firstmetal Gale Charm
firstmetal_gale_charm.desc: A charm set with galequill in firstmetal. Wind abilities cost less essence.

firstmetal_gale_talisman.name: Firstmetal Gale Talisman
firstmetal_gale_talisman.desc: A talisman of galequill bound in firstmetal wire. Wind abilities hit a little harder.

firstmetal_storm_charm.name: Firstmetal Storm Charm
firstmetal_storm_charm.desc: A charm set with fulgurite in firstmetal. Lightning abilities cost less essence.

firstmetal_storm_talisman.name: Firstmetal Storm Talisman
firstmetal_storm_talisman.desc: A talisman of fulgurite bound in firstmetal wire. Lightning abilities hit a little harder.

firstmetal_cooling_coil.name: Firstmetal Cooling Coil
firstmetal_cooling_coil.desc: A coil of firstmetal that runs cold when you run hot. Reflux bleeds off a little faster.

dawn_floss_menders_thread.name: Dawn-Floss Mender's Thread
dawn_floss_menders_thread.desc: A thread of dawn-floss soaked in first bloom, wound round the wrist. Healing spent on a lasting wound goes further.

decad_mote.name: Decad Mote
decad_mote.desc: A 10-star satellite. It trickles 10 essence a second into you whether you ask or not. Satellites are found or bought; nobody in town can make one.

first_bloom_poultice.name: First Bloom Poultice
first_bloom_poultice.desc: First Bloom bound in cloth. Out of a fight it returns a fifth of your health over ten seconds and speeds natural healing for five minutes. Ordinary medicine; the star does not mind.

first_bloom_salve.name: First Bloom Salve
first_bloom_salve.desc: Rubbed into your oldest lasting wound, it does 127 points of the healing that wound is waiting for. Slower than the bonesetter, and you can carry it.

first_struck_regrowth_draught.name: First-Struck Regrowth Draught
first_struck_regrowth_draught.desc: Drunk in a safe place, it grows back a lost arm over the night. It itches for a week.

first_struck_clotting_powder.name: First-Struck Clotting Powder
first_struck_clotting_powder.desc: Thrown into a wound mid-fight: bleeding stops, and the next wound you take is a quarter shallower.

dawn_thistle_draught.name: Dawn Thistle Draught
dawn_thistle_draught.desc: 300 essence, now. It leaves 15 reflux on every affinity, and the delve teaches you a little less.

deep_kelp_paste.name: Deep Kelp Paste
deep_kelp_paste.desc: Cold, grey and smelling of pennies. Takes 57 reflux off every affinity. The delve teaches you a little less for it.

first_struck_steadying_tonic.name: First-Struck Steadying Tonic
first_struck_steadying_tonic.desc: Two minutes of steadier feet (more poise), then a minute of wobbling. The delve teaches you a little less.

first_struck_yard_liniment.name: First-Struck Yard Liniment
first_struck_yard_liniment.desc: Rubbed in before a tempering session: the strain it leaves is smaller, and so is what you learn.

first_struck_pale_tincture.name: First-Struck Pale Tincture
first_struck_pale_tincture.desc: An ascension aid. It pours blank growth into your newest star. The star fills; what it fills with is nobody in particular. Too many and the talent itself starts to wear.

first_struck_sap_venom.name: First-Struck Sap Venom
first_struck_sap_venom.desc: For 15 base strikes each hit poisons for 98.7 a second over five seconds. Poison you laid pays your talent like any other harm.

first_struck_lead_lacquer.name: First-Struck Lead Lacquer
first_struck_lead_lacquer.desc: A heavy lacquer for a weapon's head. For 20 base strikes they break poise half again as fast.

first_struck_smoke_pot.name: First-Struck Smoke Pot
first_struck_smoke_pot.desc: Thrown: a bank of smoke three metres across. Nothing shoots through it.

first_struck_second_skin_wax.name: First-Struck Second-Skin Wax
first_struck_second_skin_wax.desc: Rubbed on the temples: your next projection has 7 more life.

first_struck_trail_ration.name: First-Struck Trail Ration
first_struck_trail_ration.desc: Hard bread, dried fruit and something salted. For an hour of the clock natural healing runs a quarter faster.

firstmetal_tipped_arrows.name: Firstmetal-Tipped Arrows
firstmetal_tipped_arrows.desc: Twenty arrows with firstmetal heads. About half come back.

firstmetal_bolts.name: Firstmetal Bolts
firstmetal_bolts.desc: Twelve short bolts, firstmetal to the shoulder. Most can be dug out.

firstmetal_shot.name: Firstmetal Shot
firstmetal_shot.desc: Thirty cast firstmetal bullets for a sling. Gone once thrown.

firstmetal_barbed_arrows.name: Firstmetal Barbed Arrows

toll_pike.name: Toll-Pike
toll_pike.effect_text: The bonus for striking at the tip is doubled, and it reaches further than any partisan.
toll_pike.desc: It was set across a road to stop carts. It still thinks it decides who goes past.

frostbitten_brigandine.name: Frostbitten Brigandine
frostbitten_brigandine.effect_text: Ten more points of wound resistance than any brigandine of its kind.
frostbitten_brigandine.desc: Cold went into the plates and stayed. Blows go numb on it, and so does the mending.

second_mouth.name: The Second Mouth
second_mouth.effect_text: Every ability hits 12% harder, whatever its affinity.
second_mouth.desc: A small carved mouth on a thong. Whatever you cast, it says too.

gutter_star.name: Gutter Star
gutter_star.effect_text: Two stars more flow than it should have.
gutter_star.desc: A seven-point flow from a five-point stone. The residue has to go somewhere, and it goes into you.

grasping_gauntlets.name: Grasping Gauntlets
grasping_gauntlets.effect_text: Base strikes break poise a fifth faster.
grasping_gauntlets.desc: They close a little tighter than you told them to, every time.

widows_draw.name: Widow's Draw
widows_draw.effect_text: Shots hit almost a fifth harder than any recurve of its band.
widows_draw.desc: Strung for someone who never had to look behind her. She was wrong once.

unmooring_shoes.name: Unmooring Shoes
unmooring_shoes.effect_text: A tenth faster on your feet.
unmooring_shoes.desc: Every step pushes off something that is not quite the ground.

choir_crown.name: Choir Crown
choir_crown.effect_text: Reflux pain starts ten points later.
choir_crown.desc: A ring of small bells that never ring. You hear them anyway, when you run hot.

debt_wall.name: Debt Wall
debt_wall.effect_text: Its guard is more than half again as deep as any heater shield of its band.
debt_wall.desc: A door off a debtor's prison, cut down and strapped to an arm. It has held back worse than you.

last_word.name: Last Word
last_word.effect_text: It strikes harder than any greatsword of its band.
last_word.desc: Whatever it is used on, the argument is over. It keeps the satisfaction for itself.

unwritten_name.name: Unwritten Name
unwritten_name.effect_text: Every ability costs 15% less essence, whatever its affinity.
unwritten_name.desc: A tag with a name on it that slides away when you read it.

unmade_coat.name: Unmade Coat
unmade_coat.effect_text: More armour and wound resistance than any plate of its band.
unmade_coat.desc: Not stitched or forged; it was simply never undone. It keeps you whole, and keeps a little of what you would have become.

tallymans_thumb.name: Tallyman's Thumb
tallymans_thumb.effect_text: Remains you pick up weigh 15% less in your pack (grows to 30%).

grows.condition: kilograms of remains sold in town

tallymans_thumb.desc: A brass thumb-cover off a scale-keeper's hand. Things weigh what it says they weigh.

patient_spear.name: The Patient Spear
patient_spear.effect_text: Each half second you stand still adds 5% to your next base strike, up to 50% (grows to 80%).

grows.condition: kills made without having moved for 2 s

patient_spear.desc: The point never moves until it has to. Then it has already arrived.

borrowing_star.name: Borrowing Star
borrowing_star.effect_text: No flow of its own. Each kill lends you 4 essence a second for 5 seconds; loans stack to five (grows to 8 a second).

grows.condition: kills made while three or more loans are running

borrowing_star.desc: A satellite that has been spent and spent. It runs on what you have just taken.

drakes_second_skin.name: Drake's Second Skin
drakes_second_skin.effect_text: Once a minute, a hit that would leave a lasting wound is taken by the coat instead; it then weighs 2 kg more until you sleep (the minute shrinks to 30 s).
drakes_second_skin.desc: It sloughs. It grows back thicker, and heavier, every time.

choir_pipe.name: Choir Pipe
choir_pipe.effect_text: Each shot vents 3 from every affinity you hold and does 40% more for each one that was above 50 (grows to 60%).

grows.condition: affinities kept above 80 without locking, a minute at a time

choir_pipe.desc: Five reeds bound into one pipe. Whatever you are running hot on, it sings.

still_mask.name: The Still Mask
still_mask.effect_text: After 2 seconds without moving, archers and casters lose their aim on you (the wait shrinks to 1 s).

grows.condition: shots that lost their aim on you

still_mask.desc: A face with no expression and no breath. Things looking for you look past it.

echo_coin.name: Echo Coin
echo_coin.effect_text: Every tenth base strike lands twice; the echo does half (grows to every seventh, at 70%).
echo_coin.desc: A coin that is heads in one world and tails in the other.

heartmetal_tithe.name: Heartmetal Tithe
heartmetal_tithe.effect_text: A base strike also takes 1% of what the target has left, never more than the strike itself (grows to 2%).
heartmetal_tithe.desc: It does not cut so much as collect. It is never in a hurry.

first_word.name: First Word
first_word.effect_text: The first skill you cast in each fight costs no essence and leaves no reflux (grows to the first two).

grows.condition: fights opened that way and won

first_word.desc: A tablet with one word on it. You will not be able to read it until you have said it.

unwritten_page.name: Unwritten Page
unwritten_page.effect_text: Copies the stat line of the other trinket you wear at half strength (grows to full).

grows.condition: different trinkets worn beside it for a whole delve

unwritten_page.desc: Blank. Hold it beside something else and it remembers what it saw.

the_unmade_thing.name: The Unmade Thing
the_unmade_thing.effect_text: Its family is that of the last weapon you held in your main hand, and its numbers are that family's at its band (each family mastered adds 2% damage, to 14%).
the_unmade_thing.desc: It is shaped like whatever you expect. Nobody has seen it twice the same.

hollow_band.name: Hollow Band
hollow_band.effect_text: Hides the aura of what it holds (design/10 'Loud' rule).
hollow_band.desc: A ring with room inside it. You reach in with your attention, not your hand, and what is stowed deep stays put. It takes the place of whatever you carried on your back, and nothing in it can be felt from outside.
